Here, we establish temporal and spectral charge--spin separation as a general transport signature across all spin-splitting classes of collinear and noncollinear odd-parity magnets with unitary spin-flip inversion $\mathcal U=[C_2^\perp\Vert P]$. This symmetry restricts charge responses to odd orders and $z$-polarized spin responses to even orders, independent of microscopic mechanism and without requiring spin conservation. For ac drives that reverse sign after half a period, charge and spin currents exhibit opposite half-period parities, and their spectra contain only odd charge and even spin harmonics. This allows dc spin rectification without a dc charge counterpart, even in longitudinal transport and beyond weak fields. We show that although antiunitary $\mathcal Tτ$ enforces odd-parity bands, it reverses the charge--spin selection of Berry-curvature and Berry-curvature-dipole responses, providing a direct transport fingerprint distinguishing the two protecting symmetries. We verify the selection rules for all linear and second-order transport mechanisms and demonstrate harmonic separation in a minimal odd-parity model, representative Floquet-engineered collinear MnPS$_3$, and the equilibrium noncollinear VCl$_2$ family.

AI.tldr: 本文确立：对具有酉自旋翻转反演 U=[C₂^⊥‖P] 的奇宇称磁体，电荷响应只允许奇阶、z 偏振自旋响应只允许偶阶，从而在交流驱动下实现电荷—自旋的时间与频谱分离，并可用作区分不同保护对称性的输运指纹。
AI.motivation: 偶宇称交错磁体（altermagnet）已有晶体自旋霍尔效应作为电荷—自旋空间分离的特征输运对应物，但奇宇称磁体缺乏类似的"定义性"输运特征，本文旨在填补这一空白。
AI.method: 从对称性出发，考察共线与非共线奇宇称磁体自旋劈裂各类别中共有的酉自旋翻转反演对称 U=[C₂^⊥‖P]；推导其对电荷与自旋响应阶数的选择定则（不依赖微观机制、不要求自旋守恒）；分析交流驱动下半周期宇称与谐波谱结构；并逐一核验线性与二阶各类输运机制（含贝里曲率与贝里曲率偶极响应）；在最小奇宇称模型、Floquet 工程化共线 MnPS₃ 以及非共线 VCl₂ 体系中演示。
AI.result: 半周期反号的交流驱动下，电荷流与自旋流呈相反的半周期宇称，频谱中仅含奇次电荷谐波与偶次自旋谐波；可在无直流电荷对应物的情况下实现直流自旋整流，且在纵向输运与强场下依然成立；反幺正 Tτ 虽保证奇宇称能带，却反转贝里曲率类响应的电荷—自旋选择，形成区分两种保护对称性的直接输运指纹；三类模型均验证了谐波分离。
AI.conclusion: 时间与频谱的电荷—自旋分离是全部奇宇称磁体自旋劈裂类别的普适输运标志，其选择规则由单一酉对称决定、与微观机制无关，并可作为判别保护对称性的实验可测指纹。

title: Scheduling the quantum implementation of the Trotter decomposition for Hamiltonian simulation
summary: For the quantum computational task for Hamiltonian simulation, the arrangement in which sub-Hamiltonians appear in the Trotter decomposition may have a large influence on the precision, under a given circuit complexity. In this paper, we design several scheduling strategies by combining two methods; that is, the existing simultaneous diagonalization scheme leveraged in order to guarantee the performance in a relatively short circuit depth, with a method inspired from a Trotter-Suzuki decomposition of the second or the fourth order for a better accuracy. By conducting numerical simulations on various Hamiltonian instances, we confirm a systematic advantage over previous methods. Thus, our proposal may eliminate the need of dealing with several Hamiltonian-dependent scheduling strategies.

AI.tldr: 本文将「同时对角化」调度与二阶/四阶 Trotter-Suzuki 分解相结合，设计多种子哈密顿量排序（调度）策略，在固定电路复杂度下提升哈密顿量模拟精度，并在多个数值算例上系统性地优于已有方法。
AI.motivation: 哈密顿量模拟中，在给定电路复杂度（如门数、深度）约束下，各子哈密顿量在 Trotter 分解中的排列顺序会显著影响模拟精度；已有方法往往依赖具体哈密顿量（Hamiltonian-dependent）的定制调度策略，缺乏通用性。
AI.method: 提出将两类方法组合的调度策略：一方面沿用已有的同时对角化（simultaneous diagonalization）方案，以保证在较短电路深度下的性能；另一方面借鉴二阶或四阶 Trotter-Suzuki 分解的结构来安排子哈密顿量的出现顺序，以获得更高精度。随后在多种哈密顿量实例上进行数值模拟验证。
AI.result: 数值实验表明，所提调度策略相较于先前方法具有系统性的优势（一致的精度提升），且在不同哈密顿量实例上表现稳健。
AI.conclusion: 该工作有望免除针对不同哈密顿量逐一设计专用调度策略的需要，提供一种较为通用、精度更优的 Trotter 调度方案。

title: Adaptive obstacle deposition drives dynamical localization in chase-and-escape dynamics
summary: Most pursuit--evasion models assume a fixed environment, although defensive actions can leave persistent structures that affect subsequent encounters. We study a two-dimensional lattice model in which threatened escapers deposit permanent obstacles, coupling capture kinetics to the geometry explored by their pursuers. Increasing the deposition probability enhances escaper survival and strongly suppresses chaser transport. For dilute chasers, the mean-squared-displacement exponent decreases from values near unity towards zero, trajectories contract to a few lattice spacings and the localized fraction rises sharply. The localization response becomes weaker as chaser abundance increases. Time-resolved obstacle densities support a kinetic explanation: rapid capture depletes obstacle-producing escapers before a comparably confining environment can develop. At intermediate parameters, broad or bimodal distributions of trajectory radii and MSD exponents reveal simultaneous mobile and localized subpopulations. Thus deposition redistributes trajectories between distinct dynamical behaviors, producing heterogeneity beyond a uniform slowdown. We summarize the coupled survival and transport response in an empirical map of mobile, heterogeneous and trapping-dominated regimes, interpreted as finite-time crossovers. These results identify the lifetime of the obstacle-producing population as a key control of adaptive localization: a stronger instantaneous pursuit pressure can weaken confinement by shortening the period over which the environment is modified.

AI.tldr: 本文研究追逃模型中逃逸者持续留下永久障碍物对环境几何的影响，发现沉积概率提升会增强逃逸者存活并强烈抑制追逐者输运，稀释追逐者条件下MSD指数由近1降至近0、轨迹收缩并出现强局域化；该响应随追逐者数量增加而减弱，机制是快速捕获耗尽造障逃逸者种群。
AI.motivation: 多数追逃模型假定环境固定，但防御行为可留下持久结构从而影响后续遭遇；作者希望将捕获动力学与追逐者所探索的几何耦合起来。
AI.method: 构建二维格点模型：受威胁的逃逸者以概率沉积永久障碍物；统计不同沉积概率与追逐者密度下的存活率、均方位移(MSD)指数、轨迹半径分布、局域化比例，以及时间分辨的障碍密度，并据此给出经验相图（可动、异质、俘获主导区）。
AI.result: 沉积概率升高显著提升逃逸者存活并强抑制追逐者输运；稀疏追逐者时MSD指数从近1降至趋近0，轨迹收缩至数格距，局域化比例陡增；中途参数下轨迹半径与MSD指数呈宽分布或双峰，显示可动与局域子群共存；该局域化响应随追逐者丰度增加而减弱。
AI.conclusion: 沉积在“可动”与“局域”两种动力学行为之间重新分配轨迹，产生超越均匀减速的异质性；造障种群的寿命是自适应局域化的关键控制量——更强的瞬时机追捕压力会因缩短环境被改造的时长而反而削弱束缚效果。相图边界可理解为有限时间交叉。

title: Nonmonotonic Magnetic Correlations in Decorated Lieb-Lattice Anderson Models
summary: The interplay between electronic correlations and lattice geometry can strongly modify the competition between magnetic correlations and local singlet formation in multiorbital Hamiltonians. Here we use determinant quantum Monte Carlo simulations to investigate two periodic Anderson-like models constructed by selectively hybridizing localized orbitals to the inequivalent sites of a Lieb lattice. The resulting geometries possess partially filled flat bands and different sublattice imbalances. We examine the evolution of local spin correlations and orbital-resolved magnetic structure factors as the hybridization is increased. Although correlations between hybridized orbitals evolve relatively smoothly toward local singlet formation, the longer-range magnetic correlations exhibit a striking nonmonotonic dependence on hybridization. In particular, we observe a pronounced suppression at intermediate hybridization followed by a substantial recovery on undecorated lattice sites. We discuss these results in relation to earlier studies of depleted periodic Anderson models and the constraints imposed by Lieb's theorem. Our findings illustrate how selective hybridization and flat-band structure can produce unusual redistributions of magnetic correlations in strongly interacting multiorbital systems.

AI.tldr: 利用行列式量子蒙特卡罗研究Lieb晶格上选择性杂化构建的周期Anderson型模型，发现长程磁关联随杂化强度呈显著非单调演化：中等杂化处被强烈压制，随后在未装饰格点上大幅恢复。
AI.motivation: 电子关联与晶格几何的相互作用会改变多轨道体系中磁关联与局域单态形成之间的竞争，需厘清平带与子晶格失衡如何调控这一竞争。
AI.method: 采用行列式量子蒙特卡罗（DQMC）模拟两个周期Anderson型模型：将局域轨道选择性杂化到Lieb晶格的不等价格点上，构造具有部分填充平带和不同子晶格失衡的几何结构；随杂化强度演化考察局域自旋关联与轨道分辨的磁结构因子。
AI.result: 杂化轨道之间的关联较平滑地趋向局域单态形成，而长程磁关联对杂化呈显著非单调依赖：中等杂化下被明显压制，随后在未装饰格点上大幅恢复。
AI.conclusion: 结果与贫化周期Anderson模型的已有研究及Lieb定理约束相联系，表明选择性杂化与平带结构可在强关联多轨道体系中产生磁关联的异常重分布。

title: Thermo-electric Response Bound on Fluctuations in Coherent Transport
summary: We establish an accessible lower bound on current noise in coherent electron transport, expressed in terms of responses to reservoir temperatures and chemical potentials. Derived within the Floquet-Nambu scattering formalism using a Cramér-Rao-type inequality, it holds for arbitrary linear combinations of charge and heat currents in normal terminals, including those of hybrid superconducting systems, under static or periodic driving. The bound is tight in experimentally relevant regimes, notably in quantum point contacts with static or oscillating voltages and normal-superconductor junctions, often providing stronger constraints than thermodynamic uncertainty relations. It can be evaluated via experimentally accessible response coefficients, without inferring entropy production or dynamical activity, and provides useful constraints on the precision of nanoscale thermal and quantum devices.

AI.tldr: 该文在Floquet-Nambu散射框架下，利用Cramér-Rao型不等式，建立了相干电子输运中电流噪声的一个可由实验直接获取的下界，该界以对热库温度与化学势的响应系数表示，适用于普通及混合超导端口中电荷流与热流的任意线性组合，且在QPC与N-S结等实验情形下是紧的，常强于热力学不确定关系。
AI.motivation: 已有的噪声下界（如热力学不确定关系）通常需要熵产生或动力学活性等难以直接测量的量，且对周期性驱动与混合超导体系的适用性有限，因此需要一个仅依赖实验可测响应系数、适用于更广体系的电流噪声下界。
AI.method: 在Floquet-Nambu散射形式体系内，基于Cramér-Rao型不等式推导；下界由对热库温度与化学势的响应系数构造，覆盖普通端口及混合超导系统中电荷流与热流的任意线性组合，并兼容静态与周期驱动情形。
AI.result: 所导出的下界在实验相关区间是紧的：在静态或振荡偏压下的量子点接触（QPC）以及正常金属-超导体（N-S）结中均得到验证，且往往比热力学不确定关系给出更强的约束。
AI.conclusion: 该下界无需推断熵产生或动力学活性，仅用实验可测的响应系数即可评估，为纳米尺度热学与量子器件的精度提供了实用约束。

title: Analog Explorations of Quantum State Measurement
summary: The awkward disconnect in the postulates of quantum mechanics between the continuous, deterministic, linear, and unitary evolution governed by Schrödinger's equation and the discontinuous, stochastic, nonlinear, and nonunitary measurement process has vexed physicists for decades. Intuition from classical mechanics, statistical mechanics, and dynamical systems theory suggests that such a process might be modeled with a nonlinear system of differential equations. We explore such approaches by designing a deterministic model of an ideal projective measurement on a single qubit and constructing an analog computer that simulates it by manipulating voltages in an electrical circuit. The model reduces to Schrödinger evolution when no measurement is taking place. During a measurement, a hidden variable that the observer does not resolve selects the outcome, and the model is constructed so that a uniformly distributed hidden variable yields Born-rule frequencies. We do not derive the Born rule; rather, we show that a deterministic dynamical system with no intrinsic noise can implement it. Over 300 trials, the circuit reproduces the ideal model's individual outcomes to within one percent of the decision threshold, and its outcome frequencies match the Born rule to within about 0.02 in probability. These results are a small but provocative step towards modeling quantum measurement with macro-scale machines---a step of interest for both the foundations of physics and the alternatives to digital computing it suggests.

AI.tldr: 该文设计了一个确定性的单量子比特理想投影测量模型，其无测量时退化为薛定谔演化，测量时由未分辨的隐变量选取结果、均匀隐变量给出玻恩规则频率，并用电压操控的电子线路（模拟计算机）实现；300余次试验中电路复现个体结果与判决阈值误差在1%以内，频率与玻恩规则偏差约0.02。
AI.motivation: 量子力学中连续的、确定的、线性酉演化（薛定谔方程）与不连续的、随机的、非线性非酉的测量过程之间存在令人困扰的断裂，物理学家为此争论数十年；经典力学、统计力学与动力系统理论的直觉暗示该过程或可用非线性微分方程组建模，作者意在探索这类确定性动力学途径。
AI.method: 构造单量子比特理想投影测量的确定性模型：无测量发生时模型退化为薛定谔演化；测量时由一个观察者未分辨的隐变量决定结果，模型设计使均匀分布的隐变量产生符合玻恩规则的频率（并非推导玻恩规则，而是证明无内禀噪声的确定性动力系统可实现它）。随后设计电子线路中的模拟计算机，通过操控电压仿真该模型，并进行300余次实验验证。
AI.result: 300余次试验中，电路复现理想模型的个体结果与判决阈值的偏差在1%以内；其结果频率与玻恩规则的吻合在概率上约0.02以内。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，无内禀噪声的确定性动力系统可实现玻恩规则，并以宏观尺度机器（模拟计算）建模量子测量，这对物理学基础问题及数字计算的替代方案均有启发意义，是一个虽小但具挑衅性的进展。

title: Disk 2-point functions for conformal loop ensemble: a derivation from the SLE loop CFT
comment: 27 pages, 2 figures. This paper is aimed at theoretical physicists. In particular, not all arguments are mathematically rigorous
summary: We give a derivation of the bulk two-point functions of two-dimensional critical loop models in the disk based on conformal loop ensembles (CLE) and the conformal field theory of SLE loop measures developed by Baverez--Jego. Combining local Ward identities with the spectral resolution of the SLE-loop CFT, we express the two-point functions as contour integrals involving known CLE three-point structure constants and Virasoro conformal blocks. With a suitable choice of contour, these integrals are absolutely convergent and provide a unified representation of a broad class of correlation functions, valid for both irrational and rational central charges. For irrational central charges, evaluating these integrals by residues determines the discrete closed-channel spectrum and yields expansions that agree with the analytic bootstrap predictions of Downing--Jacobsen--Nivesvivat--Ribault--Saleur.

AI.tldr: 本文基于CLE与Baverez–Jego建立的SLE环测度共形场论，将二维临界环模型的盘内体两点函数表示为含CLE三点结构常数与Virasoro共形块的围道积分，并证明其收敛性、给出无理与有理中心荷下的统一表示及闭道谱。
AI.motivation: 临界环模型（如O(n)环模型）的体关联函数缺乏系统、严格的推导框架；既有解析bootstrap结果多为级数预言，需要一个能统一处理无理与有理中心荷、并从第一性原理导出的表示。
AI.method: 以CLE及SLE环测度CFT为出发点，结合局域Ward恒等式与SLE环CFT的谱分解，将两点函数写成围道积分：被积函数为已知CLE三点结构常数与Virasoro共形块之积；并选取合适围道以保证绝对收敛。
AI.result: 所得积分表示对广泛一类关联函数统一有效，涵盖无理与有理中心荷；对无理中心荷，用留数法求值可确定离散的闭道谱，所得展开与DJNRS的解析bootstrap预言一致。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为临界环模型关联函数提供了严格的、非微扰的围道积分表述，沟通了CLE/SLE环CFT与解析bootstrap两条路线，并为一般中心荷下的谱结构提供了判据。

title: Role of antisite disorder in dictating the Ising anisotropy and ferromagnetic ground state of NdGaSi
summary: Single-ion anisotropy and exchange interactions together set the magnetic ground state of rare-earth intermetallics, yet the role of chemical disorder on the ligand sublattice remains little explored. Here, we show that Ga/Si antisite disorder in NdGaSi stabilises the centrosymmetric $I4_1/amd$ structure and raises the Nd$^{3+}$ site symmetry to $D_{2d}$, which forbids all $m=\pm2$ Stevens operators in the crystalline electric field (CEF) Hamiltonian. Magnetization, specific heat, single-crystal neutron diffraction, and x-ray absorption spectroscopy establish the disordered structure and a collinear ferromagnetic order below $T_\mathrm{C}\approx11$~K with Ising anisotropy along $c$. A CEF analysis that fits the susceptibilities along both axes and the magnetic specific heat simultaneously yields a ground-state doublet that is $\sim97\%$ pure, in contrast to the strongly mixed ground state of the Al/Si-ordered NdAlSi ($C_{2v}$ site symmetry of Nd$^{3+}$). We argue that this ground-state purity makes the ordered moment rigid against the modulation due to frustrated exchange, selecting a $\mathbf{k}=0$ ferromagnet in NdGaSi instead of the incommensurate ferrimagnet of NdAlSi. Antisite disorder, thus, acts as a handle on CEF ground-state purity and can, thereby, select between fundamentally different magnetic ground states.

AI.tldr: NdGaSi中的Ga/Si反位无序稳定了中心对称的I4₁/amd结构，将Nd³⁺位点对称性提升至D₂d，从而禁戒所有m=±2的Stevens算符。这使得晶场基态双重态近乎纯净（~97%），并使有序磁矩对阻挫交换导致的调制"刚性"不响应，最终选择k=0的铁磁态而非NdAlSi的不可公度亚铁磁态。
AI.motivation: 稀土金属间化合物的磁基态由单离子各向异性与交换作用共同决定，但配体亚晶格上化学无序的作用鲜有研究。作者旨在探究Ga/Si反位无序如何通过改变晶场环境来调控磁基态。
AI.method: 结合磁化测量、比热、单晶中子衍射和X射线吸收谱确定结构与磁序；并用同时拟合两轴磁化率与磁比热的晶场（CEF）分析提取基态波函数纯度，与Al/Si有序的NdAlSi（C₂ᵥ对称性）对比。
AI.result: NdGaSi在Tc≈11 K以下呈共线铁磁序，沿c轴具Ising各向异性；CEF分析给出约97%纯净的基态双重态，而NdAlSi基态强烈混合。
AI.conclusion: 反位无序可作为调控CEF基态纯度的"手柄"，通过基态纯度差异在不同磁基态（k=0铁磁 vs 不可公度亚铁磁）之间进行选择。

title: Benchmarking Quantum Key Distribution Hardware Across Operating Conditions
comment: 12 pages, 9 figures, 5 tables. Submitted to IEEE Journal of Lightwave Technology
summary: Quantum key distribution (QKD) is entering national fibre networks, but published secret key rates (SKRs) are measured over different distances, wavelengths, classical traffic loads and clock rates, so systems are hard to compare. We write the SKR as the product of the transmitter clock rate, the channel transmittance and the secret key per received pulse. This third factor, the noise-normalised key rate (NNKR), needs four commonly reported parameters and depends mainly on the equipment wherever the SKR is proportional to transmittance. A companion metric, the implementation efficiency (IE), compares the SKR with the ideal key rate of its channel, including classical-traffic noise. For fixed loss-limited equipment, NNKR is independent of channel loss, whereas the fraction of the repeaterless bound varies 1.6-fold over 2-25 dB. An analytic model relates the flat loss range of NNKR to the detector noise count rate and dead time. We apply both metrics to ten published coexistence experiments, and NNKR to 42,115 measurements from four systems of two vendors and four high-rate laboratory systems. For one production system, NNKR has a 6.9% coefficient of variation over 17 dB of attenuation and agrees within 0.7 dB with three of four published deployments of that platform. Under coexistence, that platform's NNKR and IE stay within 0.5 dB of their standalone values. In decibels, NNKR is a sum of component penalties, as in an optical link budget, and for one laboratory system the budget from its published parameters and measured secure fraction closes within 0.3 dB.

AI.tldr: 提出噪声归一化密钥率(NNKR)与实现效率(IE)两个度量，用于跨距离、波长、经典业务负载与时钟速率下横向比较QKD系统性能。
AI.motivation: QKD已进入国家光纤网络，但已发表的安全密钥率(SKR)是在不同距离、波长、经典业务负载和时钟速率下测得的，系统之间难以公平比较，缺乏与实现无关的归一化性能度量。
AI.method: 将SKR分解为"发射端时钟速率×信道透过率×每接收脉冲密钥量"，第三项即NNKR，仅需四个常见报告参数，且在SKR与透过率成正比时主要取决于设备本身。配套指标IE将实际SKR与该信道理想密钥率（含经典业务噪声）比较。建立解析模型，将NNKR的平坦损耗范围与探测器暗计数率及死时间相关联。对10项已发表共存实验应用两指标，并对来自两家厂商4套系统及4套高速率实验室系统的42115次测量计算NNKR。
AI.result: 某量产系统在17 dB衰减范围内NNKR变异系数为6.9%，与该平台四个已发表部署中的三个吻合在0.7 dB内；共存条件下该平台NNKR与IE相对独立运行偏差在0.5 dB内。固定损耗受限设备下NNKR与信道损耗无关，而无中继界限达成比例在2–25 dB范围内变化达1.6倍。以dB计NNKR可表示为各分量惩罚之和（类似光链路预算），某实验室系统由其公开参数与实测安全占比构成的预算闭合误差在0.3 dB内。
AI.conclusion: NNKR与IE提供了可跨平台、跨信道条件横向比较QKD系统的归一化度量，具有设备依赖性稳定、可分解为链路预算形式的优点，适合作为QKD性能报告与基准测试的标准指标。

title: Pseudo-entropy in Thouless Pumps and Majorana Topological Phases
summary: We study the average excess pseudo entropy, $ΔS_{12}$, in the Rice-Mele model under Thouless pumping. We compute it for two driving schemes, the control-freak and smooth pumps, under open and periodic boundary conditions. We find that $ΔS_{12}$ distinguishes the trivial, monomer, and topological stages of the pump, and that it depends on the boundary condition, the driving scheme, and the reference time. We also find that a nonzero staggered potential breaks chiral symmetry and gaps out the SSH critical point, thereby flattening the pseudo-entropy peak at the phase boundary. We also study reference-state dependence in the open Kitaev chain, comparing a fixed even-parity target with five reference families: even free-fermion, pairing-only, vacuum, and two fixed gapped states. We find that the pseudo-entropy response depends on the reference and on the parity of the subsystem size, even when the reference remains gapped. At $μ=0$, the pairing-only reference gives the exact result $S_{\mathrm{pr}}=\ln 2$ for $L=4m+2$, while the $L=4m$ sequence has analytically determined finite-size corrections. These results show that, in both models, pseudo entropy is a property of the reference-target pair and the subsystem partition, rather than a reference-independent signature of the topological phase.

AI.tldr: 本文计算Rice-Mele模型Thouless泵浦中的平均过剩赝熵ΔS12（对比control-freak与smooth两种驱动、开/周期边界），并在开放Kitaev链中比较五种参考态，发现赝熵依赖边界条件、驱动方案、参考时间与子系统划分，是参考-目标对的性质而非拓扑相的普适指标。
AI.motivation: 研究赝熵（pseudo entropy）是否可作为拓扑泵浦中各阶段的可靠判据，并厘清其对边界条件、驱动方案、参考时间与参考态的依赖。
AI.method: 在Thouless泵浦下的Rice-Mele模型中，计算控制型（control-freak）与平滑泵浦两种驱动方案在开/周期边界条件下的平均超额赝熵ΔS₁₂；在开边界Kitaev链中，将固定偶宇称目标态与五类参考态（偶自由费米子、纯配对、真空、两个固定有能隙态）进行比较。
AI.result: ΔS₁₂能区分泵浦的平庸、单聚体与拓扑阶段，但其取值依赖边界条件、驱动方案与参考时间；非零交错势破坏手征对称性并使SSH临界点打开能隙，从而压平相边界处的赝熵峰。Kitaev链中赝熵响应依赖参考态与子系统尺寸宇称；μ=0时纯配对参考在L=4m+2给出精确S_pr=ln2，L=4m序列具有可解析的有限尺寸修正。
AI.conclusion: 赝熵是参考态–目标态对与子系统划分的联合属性，而非与参考态无关的拓扑相内在特征。

title: Lattice-geometry dependence of Type-I and Type-II magnetic flux responses in strongly correlated bosons
summary: Superfluids and superconductors are classified into Type-I and Type-II according to their response to a magnetic flux, but this classification has hardly been addressed for lattice bosons under magnetic flux, where the Meissner and vortex phases have been studied mostly in ladder geometries. Here, we study the flux response of the extended Bose-Hubbard model with nearest-neighbor interaction $V$ at half filling on square and triangular ladders with two to four legs by using the density-matrix renormalization group. On the square ladders, the vortex phase is confined to a region near $V=0$. At finite $V$, a magnetic flux-induced charge-density-wave (CDW) order replaces it, and the response becomes Type-I-like. In contrast, on the triangular ladders, the vortex phase persists over the whole range of $V$ studied, and the response remains Type-II-like. By extrapolating the ladder results to two dimensions, we argue that the Type-I or Type-II character of the flux response depends on the lattice geometry, which suggests a role of geometric frustration.

AI.tldr: 本文用DMRG研究半满扩展Bose-Hubbard模型在正方形与三角形梯子上的磁通响应，发现方梯子中涡旋相仅在V≈0附近存在、有限V下被磁通诱导的CDW序取代而呈Type-I型；三角梯子中涡旋相在整个V范围内持续、呈Type-II型。外推至二维表明通量响应类型取决于晶格几何（几何阻挫）。
AI.motivation: 超流/超导体按磁通响应分为Type-I与Type-II，但这一分类在磁通下的晶格玻色子体系中几乎未被讨论，既有Meissner相与涡旋相研究多局限于梯子几何（且多为简单情形）。作者希望厘清最近邻相互作用与晶格几何如何决定通量响应类型。
AI.method: 采用密度矩阵重正化群（DMRG）计算半满、带最近邻相互作用V的扩展Bose-Hubbard模型，在2~4条腿的正方形与三角形梯子上施加磁通，通过比较Meissner相与涡旋相（及CDW序）的相图来判定Type-I/Type-II行为，并将梯子结果外推至二维。
AI.result: 方梯子：涡旋相被限制在V≈0附近区域；有限V时出现磁通诱导的电荷密度波（CDW）序取代涡旋相，响应转为Type-I-like。三角梯子：涡旋相在所研究的整个V范围内持续存在，响应保持Type-II-like。
AI.conclusion: 磁通响应属Type-I还是Type-II依赖于晶格几何，几何阻挫（三角晶格的阻挫性）在其中起关键作用；作者据此推测二维极限下的行为。

title: Resonance-controlled post-selected mode entanglement in one-dimensional quantum scattering
comment: 17 pages, 3 figures. Submitted to Physica Scripta
summary: We study resonance-controlled post-selected mode entanglement in a one-dimensional quantum-scattering model. Two incoming electrons scatter independently from a symmetric double-barrier structure and the sector with one reflected and one transmitted electron is selected. The idealised delta-function barriers used in earlier work are replaced by exponentially localised cusp barriers, $U(x)=U_0\exp(-|x\mp d/2|/a)$, for which the single-barrier scattering problem is exactly solvable in terms of modified Bessel functions of imaginary order. We derive the corresponding reflection and transmission amplitudes, verify their current normalisation and validate them independently by direct numerical integration. Two separated cusp barriers are then combined through a Fabry-Pérot composition, whose accuracy is quantified by solving the full two-centre Schrödinger equation. In the well-separated regime the approximation reproduces the full resonance positions to high accuracy. The concurrence zeros are controlled by the resonance phase condition $δ(κ)+κd=nπ$, with a continuously unwrapped single-barrier reflection phase $δ$. We also calculate the post-selection probability $P_{RT}$, showing explicitly that large conditional concurrence can occur in a low-probability sector. Systematic scans in barrier width, integrated strength and reference momentum show that finite width can shift off-resonant concurrence maxima and, depending on the reference momentum, reduce their attainable height. The results identify resonance-controlled conditional entanglement as a robust feature of the well-separated double-barrier geometry rather than an artefact of the zero-range idealisation.

AI.tldr: 将理想化delta势替换为指数局域化的cusp势，验证单势垒与双势垒（Fabry-Pérot）散射结果，表明共振控制的后选择模式纠缠不被有限势宽抹去，但其零点与最大高度会随势宽、耦合强度与参考动量移动。
AI.motivation: 先前关于一维双势垒散射中后选择模式纠缠的研究使用零程delta势的理想化模型，其有限势宽的可信度未知；需检验共振控制的条件纠缠是几何结构的内禀特征还是零程近似的产物。
AI.method: 两个电子独立地散射于对称双势垒，筛选一反射一透射扇区（RT后选择）；采用cusp势 U(x)=U0 exp(-|x∓d/2|/a)，单势垒问题借虚阶修正贝塞尔函数精确求解，得到反射/透射振幅并进行流归一化校核与直接数值积分验证；双势垒由Fabry-Pérot合成，以其与完整双中心薛定谔方程的解对比量化精度；用共振相位条件 δ(κ)+κd=nπ（δ为连续展开的单势垒反射相位）定位concurrence零点，并计算后选择概率 P_RT。
AI.result: 在良分离（大间距）区域，Fabry-Pérot近似高精度重现完整双中心解的全部共振位置；concurrence零点由共振相位条件支配；P_RT的计算显示大条件concurrence可出现在低概率扇区；对势宽、积分强度与参考动量的扫描表明有限宽度可移动非共振concurrence极大值，并随参考动量降低其可达高度。
AI.conclusion: 共振控制的（后选择）条件纠缠是良分离双势垒几何的稳健特征，而非零程理想化的假象；有限势宽主要修正非共振区的极大位置与高度，而共振零点结构由相位条件稳定描述。

title: The Fiscal and Economic Implications of Green Mandates: a Boltzmann Approach to Public Governance
summary: Public authorities increasingly need to translate multifaceted policy objectives into concrete fiscal and investment choices while accounting for their socioeconomic consequences. A credible ex-ante impact assessment should report downstream implications attributable to the historical baseline and specified policy targets, without introducing discretionary assumptions about unknown administrative, socioeconomic or other physical processes. Bringing the large-scale perspective of statistical physics to public governance, we construct such an ex-ante impact assessment. Its scope encompasses policy objectives that condition a finite number of generalized moments of observables in the historical baseline, which comprises a sufficiently large collection of projects or public programmes. As a proof-of-principle application, we consider the green transition in the energy-generation sector using the historical baseline of many infrastructure projects from the World Bank. Our earlier results deriving closed-form expressions for coarse-grained combinatorial probabilities enable a tractable statistical and downstream assessment. We assess the statistical compatibility of the historical baseline with different levels of green-power surplus and demonstrate how the same statistical-physics construction can estimate any downstream metric expressible through arbitrary functions of generalized moments of the baseline observables. In the absence of more detailed knowledge about the processes forming the historical baseline, large-scale universality, whenever many unknown influences on collective phenomena become negligible, unambiguously offers a principled route to a self-contained ex-ante impact assessment.

AI.tldr: 将统计物理的大规模视角引入公共治理，构建仅依赖历史基线与政策目标的"事前影响评估"框架，并以世界银行能源基础设施项目的绿色转型为例验证其可行性。
AI.motivation: 公共部门需将多元政策目标转化为具体财政与投资选择并评估其社会经济后果，但可信的事前评估应只报告由历史基线和既定政策目标所决定的下游影响，而不引入对未知行政、社会经济或物理过程的主观假设，现有方法难以满足这一要求。
AI.method: 借鉴统计物理的大规模（大数/普适性）视角，构建事前评估框架：政策目标被表述为对历史基线中观测量若干广义矩的约束，基线由足够多的项目或公共计划构成；利用作者此前推导的粗粒化组合概率闭式表达式，实现对约束下组合分布的可处理统计推断，并将任意由基线观测量广义矩的任意函数表达的下游指标纳入估计。
AI.result: 以世界银行众多基础设施项目构成的历史基线为原理性验证案例，评估了能源发电部门绿色转型情景：量化了历史基线与不同绿色电力盈余水平的统计相容性，并展示了同一构造可估计任意可通过广义矩函数表达的下游指标，且计算上可行。
AI.conclusion: 在缺乏关于基线形成过程更细节知识的情况下，当众多未知影响对集体现象的作用可忽略时，大规模普适性为自洽、无额外主观假设的事前影响评估提供了有原则的路径。

title: Magnetic-Field Response of a Hyperbolic Kitaev Spin Liquid
summary: Hyperbolic geometry can give rise to Kitaev spin liquids with distinct flux structures and Majorana spectra, raising the question of how these fractionalized states respond beyond exactly solvable limits. We address this question on the Kekulé-colored hyperbolic {8,3} lattice by developing an infinite projected entangled-pair-state approach with flux-resolved loop-gas initialization and geometry-adapted tensor-network contraction. Under uniform and staggered [111] magnetic fields, we find markedly different many-body responses. The uniform field induces a sharp change between competing variational branches at weak field, whereas the polarization and mean plaquette flux evolve over a much broader field range under the staggered field. Exchange-energy competition helps explain the different response scales, while third-order effective Majorana models in a fixed-flux background exhibit contrasting low-energy spectra. Our results connect the geometry-dependent fractionalized structure of a solvable hyperbolic spin liquid to its many-body response under physical perturbations that break flux conservation.

AI.tldr: 该文在Kekulé着色的双曲{8,3}格子上发展含通量分辨环气体初始化与几何自适应收缩的iPEPS方法，研究Kitaev自旋液体在均匀与交错[111]磁场下的多体响应差异。
AI.motivation: 双曲几何可产生具有不同通量结构与马约拉纳谱的 Kitaev 自旋液体，但其在精确可解极限之外的行为未知；本文旨在研究这些分数化态对破坏通量守恒的物理微扰的响应。
AI.method: 在 Kekulé 着色的双曲 {8,3} 格子上，发展含通量分辨 loop-gas 初始化与几何自适应张量网络收缩的无限投影纠缠对态（iPEPS）方法；并在均匀与交错 [111] 磁场下结合三阶有效马约拉纳模型分析。
AI.result: 均匀磁场在弱场下引起竞争性变分分支间的陡峭转变；交错磁场下极化与平均 plaquette 通量在更宽的场范围内演化。交换能竞争解释了不同的响应尺度，固定通量背景下的三阶有效马约拉纳模型呈现对比明显的低能谱。
AI.conclusion: 本文将可解双曲自旋液体的几何依赖分数化结构与其在破坏通量守恒的物理微扰下的多体响应联系起来。

title: Molecular structure breaks universality in screening behavior of electrolyte solutions
comment: Main: 11 pages, 4 figures. SI: 12 pages, 1 figure
summary: Electrostatic screening is one of the most fundamental phenomena in electrolyte solutions. While dilute electrolytes are described by the universal Debye--Hückel theory, recent experiments have reported an apparently universal scaling law for screening lengths in concentrated electrolytes, fueling ongoing debate over anomalous underscreening. Yet, liquid state theory has been unable to determine whether molecular details of the solvent, the ions, or both should preserve or break such universality. Using machine-learned classical density functional theory, we compute numerically exact decay lengths across a hierarchy of electrolyte models of increasing molecular complexity. We find that molecular details qualitatively reshape screening: solvent attraction generates a new monotonic decay mode, solvent polarity produces re-entrant behavior, and ionic structure alone can drastically alter screening-length exponents. Consequently, no single scaling law describes screening universally across these molecularly distinct electrolytes. Our results challenge equilibrium interpretations of experimentally observed universality in concentrated electrolytes.

AI.tldr: 利用机器学习经典密度泛函理论，对逐级增加分子细节的电解质模型计算数值精确的屏蔽衰减长度，发现分子细节会定性改变屏蔽行为，不存在普适的屏蔽长度标度律。
AI.motivation: 稀溶液由普适的Debye–Hückel理论描述，但浓电解质中实验报道的"表观普适"屏蔽长度标度律引发关于反常欠屏蔽（anomalous underscreening）的持续争论；液相理论此前无法判定溶剂分子细节、离子细节还是二者共同决定了普适性是否保持或被破坏。
AI.method: 采用机器学习经典密度泛函理论（ML-CDFT），在一系列分子复杂度递增的电解质模型上计算数值精确的屏蔽长度（衰减长度），以规避传统液相理论的近似局限。
AI.result: 分子细节定性重塑屏蔽行为：溶剂吸引作用产生新的单调衰减模式；溶剂极性导致重入（re-entrant）行为；仅离子结构本身即可显著改变屏蔽长度指数。因此，在分子层面各异的电解质之间，不存在单一普适标度律。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果对以平衡态理论解释浓电解质中实验观测到的"普适性"提出质疑，表明所报道的普适性可能源于非平衡效应、模型简化或特定体系的巧合，而非电解质屏蔽的普遍规律。

title: Quantum Many-Body Scars from Operator Size
summary: We present a general construction of approximate many-body scar states in two copies of a system using a bilocal size interaction that couples one site to its partner on the other copy. For an uncoupled two-sided Hamiltonian whose terms have fixed size in an operator basis, we identify polynomially many Krylov basis states that it annihilates and that, in the thermodynamic limit, become concentrated on a single size sector. The size operator splits them into a tower of equally spaced levels that gives rise to coherent revivals characterized by collective oscillations of energy across the two copies. We provide a concrete realization of this construction in two copies of a general $q$-body nearest-neighbor spin chain, and the SYK model.

AI.tldr: 本文提出在系统两份拷贝间引入双局域"尺寸"相互作用，构造近似多体scar态的通用方案：存在多项式多个Krylov基态被无耦合哈密顿量湮灭且在热力学极限集中于单一尺寸扇区，其能量呈等间距塔状导致相干复苏与集体能量振荡；在q体近邻自旋链与SYK模型中给出具体实现。
AI.motivation: 多体scar态（量子多体疤痕）通常依赖特定可积或对称结构，缺乏在一般模型中系统构造的通用框架；本文旨在用一个双拷贝耦合机制，将"尺寸"算符作为可控工具，给出普适的scar态构造方法。
AI.method: 构造两份拷贝系统的两面哈密顿量，其各项在算符基底下具有固定"尺寸"（size）；再引入连接一拷贝第i个格点与另一拷贝对应格点的双局域尺寸相互作用。识别Krylov基中多项式多个被无耦合哈密顿量湮灭的态，并分析其在尺寸算符下的分裂结构；随后在q体近邻自旋链与SYK模型中具体实现。
AI.result: 这些态在热力学极限下集中于单一尺寸扇区；尺寸算符将其分裂为等间距能级塔，从而产生相干复苏，并表现为能量在两拷贝间的集体振荡；在两类具体模型中构造成功。
AI.conclusion: 双局域尺寸相互作用提供了一种模型无关的多体scar态生成机制，其等间距能谱结构与可观测的集体能量振荡为实验探测scar动力学给出了清晰信号。

title: Physical Learning for Autonomous Tuning of Spin Qubits in Electrostatically Defined Quantum Dots
summary: Tuning electrostatically defined quantum dots remains a primary bottleneck in the scalability of semiconductor spin qubits. While existing solutions rely on machine learning algorithms, these approaches require global information, introduce latency bottlenecks, and tax the limited cooling power available at cryogenic stages. Here, we demonstrate an FPGA-in-the-loop learning paradigm that bypasses digital computing overhead by utilizing multiplexed gradient descent (MGD) for tuning. Implemented on an FPGA and an emulated quantum dot device, our system autonomously tracks environmental drift, dynamically recovers from discrete charge jumps, and maintains steady-state stabilization in low signal-to-noise ratio regimes, without prior knowledge of the device's cross-capacitance matrix. The system also navigates the charge-stability landscape to stabilize the quantum dot around optimal operating points. These results demonstrate a ``compute-in-place'' platform, with a logic and power footprint suited to future cryo-CMOS integration, that provides autonomous stabilization of quantum dots at desired operating points, creating an auto-tuning system for spin qubits that is resilient to electrostatic drifts, changing noise profiles, and two-level fluctuations.

AI.tldr: 提出FPGA-in-the-loop的“原位计算”学习范式，用复用梯度下降（MGD）在低温端直接调谐静电定义量子点，无需全局信息与先验交叉电容矩阵，可自主跟踪漂移、从离散电荷跳变中恢复并维持稳点稳定。
AI.motivation: 静电定义量子点的调谐是半导体自旋量子比特可扩展性的主要瓶颈；现有机器学习方案依赖全局信息、引入延迟瓶颈，并消耗低温级有限的制冷功率。
AI.method: 在FPGA与仿真量子点器件上实现复用梯度下降（MGD）的闭环学习，以硬件内计算替代数字计算开销，并导航电荷稳定性图谱以锁定最优工作点。
AI.result: 系统在无交叉电容矩阵先验知识下，自主跟踪环境漂移、动态恢复离散电荷跳变、在低信噪比下保持稳态稳定，并能在电荷稳定性图谱中找到并稳定于最优工作点。
AI.conclusion: 构建了逻辑与功耗足迹适配未来cryo-CMOS集成的“compute-in-place”平台，为自旋量子比特提供对静电漂移、噪声变化和两能级涨落具有韧性的自动调谐系统。

title: Generalized Wigner-Yanase Uncertainty Bounds for Multiple Quantum Channels
summary: We derive uncertainty relations for quantum channels based on the generalized Wigner-Yanase skew information. For three channels, we obtain a product lower bound by optimizing over permutations of commutator and anticommutator pairings. For an arbitrary number of channels, we establish a lower bound on the sum of squared uncertainties and construct a hierarchy of bounds using the partial Cauchy-Schwarz inequality. These bounds are invariant under changes of Kraus representation for a fixed operator basis. The first two levels of the hierarchy coincide with the elementary arithmetic-geometric mean bound, while the intermediate levels generally depend on the ordering of the operator basis. Examples involving three and four qubit channels demonstrate the bounds and compare their performance with an earlier pairing inequality under fixed channel representations.

AI.tldr: 基于广义Wigner-Yanase skew信息推导量子信道的不确定性关系：三信道情形给出乘积型下界，任意信道数情形给出平方不确定度和的下界并构造偏Cauchy-Schwarz不等式层级。
AI.motivation: 将不确定性关系从态/可观测量层面推广到量子信道层面，并解决多信道情形下下界的构造与紧致性问题。
AI.method: 以广义Wigner-Yanase skew信息作为信道不确定性的度量；对三个信道，通过对易子与反对易子配对的置换进行优化得到乘积型下界；对任意数量信道，利用偏Cauchy-Schwarz不等式建立平方不确定度之和的下界及层级结构；在固定算子基下考察Kraus表示变换不变性。
AI.result: 所得界在固定算子基的Kraus表示变换下保持不变；层级的前两级退化为算术—几何平均型初等界，中间层级一般依赖算子基的排序；以三、四量子比特信道为例，展示了这些界并与早期在固定信道表示下的配对不等式进行了性能比较。
AI.conclusion: 该工作给出了信道层面系统化的不确定性下界框架，兼具表示不变性与可调紧致度，但中间层级的排序依赖性提示在实际应用中需关注算子基的选择。

title: Quantum computing for gearing down complex many-fermion problems
summary: Quantum computing unlocks exciting opportunities to extend first-principles calculations of quantum many-body systems beyond classical computing limits. Despite advances in algorithms and proof-of-principle experiments, large-scale {\it ab initio} calculations on noisy intermediate-scale quantum (NISQ) devices remain challenging. We introduce a quantum-classical framework that identifies compact single-particle bases to bring otherwise intractable many-fermion problems within classical reach while preserving an accurate ground-state description. We develop an efficient adaptive search scheme driven by simulated annealing that jointly optimizes natural-orbital-guided transformations and active-space selections. A quantum-assisted ground-state estimator provides search guidance using low-depth circuits and relaxed accuracy requirements, making the framework promising for NISQ devices. We demonstrate the framework's applicability for the nuclear structure of the oxygen isotopes. Our framework opens a new route to tackling complex {\it ab initio} many-fermion problems across disciplines through quantum-assisted basis reduction.

AI.tldr: 提出量子-经典混合框架，利用模拟退火驱动自适应搜索，联合优化自然轨道引导的变换与活性空间选择，借助低深度量子线路的地态估计器引导基矢约简，将难解的多费米子问题降至经典可算范围，并在氧同位素核结构上验证。
AI.motivation: NISQ设备上的大规模第一性原理（ab initio）多体计算仍受噪声与资源限制难以实现，需寻找能保留基态精度的紧凑单粒子基，以降低问题规模。
AI.method: 量子-经典混合框架：以模拟退火驱动的自适应搜索，联合优化自然轨道引导的单粒子变换与活性空间选择；用量子辅助的基态估计器（低深度线路、放宽精度要求）为搜索提供指引；应用到氧同位素的核结构计算。
AI.result: 框架在氧同位素核结构问题上展示了适用性，可将原本棘手的多费米子问题纳入经典计算能力范围，同时保持较精确的基态描述。
AI.conclusion: 通过量子辅助的基矢约简，为跨学科复杂ab initio多费米子问题开辟了新的求解路径，且对NISQ硬件具有现实可行性。

title: geodesiq: a Python package for geometric diabatic-adiabatic optimal state transfer
summary: We introduce the geodesiq Python package, which implements a geometric framework for shaping control pulses that achieve high-fidelity state transfer in multilevel quantum systems. The underlying method combines adiabatic and diabatic control into a single metric, suppressing unwanted excitations while allowing selected diabatic passages. Finding the pulse thereby reduces to solving a single first-order ordinary differential equation. We explain how to use geodesiq and illustrate its use explicitly with Landau-Zener transitions, spin-qubit initialization, adiabatic many-body ground-state preparation, and a diabatic-adiabatic transfer in a four-level system.

AI.tldr: 介绍 Python 包 geodesiq，基于几何框架设计控制脉冲，在多能级量子系统中实现高保真态转移；方法将绝热与透热控制统一到单一度规中，求脉冲归结为求解一个一阶常微分方程，并以 Landau-Zener 跃迁、自旋量子比特初始化、绝热多体基态制备及四能级透热—绝热转移为例演示用法。
AI.motivation: 在多能级量子系统中实现高保真态转移时，需抑制非目标激发，同时保留特定的透热通道；绝热与透热两类控制策略通常分立处理，缺乏统一表述与便捷工具。
AI.method: 提出几何框架，将绝热与透热控制合并为单一度规，从而在抑制不期望激发的同时允许选定透热通道；在此框架下，寻找控制脉冲等价于求解一个一阶常微分方程；并将该框架实现为开源 Python 包 geodesiq，文中给出使用说明与示例。
AI.result: 以四类场景验证：Landau-Zener 跃迁、自旋量子比特初始化、绝热多体基态制备、以及四能级系统中的透热—绝热转移，均展示了该包的具体使用流程。
AI.conclusion: geodesiq 提供了统一、简洁的几何化脉冲设计工具：单一度规兼顾绝热与透热控制，单方程求解降低设计复杂度，适用于从二能级到多能级、单体和多体的多种态转移任务。

title: Unconventional Photon Blockade in Second-Order Nonlinearity Coupled Cavities with Asymmetric Dissipation
comment: 9 pages, 4 figures. Under review at Phys. Rev. A
summary: We investigate the unconventional photon blockade in a second-order nonlinearity coupled double-cavity system with asymmetric dissipation. By treating the cavity decay rates as independent parameters, we analytically derive two exact families of optimal blockade conditions. While the first family recovers and generalizes the symmetric-dissipation results of previous studies, the second family, arising uniquely from an asymmetric dissipation ratio of $κ_B = 2κ_A$, completely locks the relative phase of the interference pathways. Importantly, we find that this asymmetric dissipation not only renders the optimal blockade condition strictly immune to frequency detuning, but also enhances the blockade depth by an order of magnitude compared to the resonant case. Furthermore, the mean photon number remains almost unaffected, proving that this enhanced robustness is achieved without sacrificing the brightness of the single-photon source. These findings offer a promising route toward robust single-photon generation in passive cavities with second-order nonlinearity.

AI.tldr: 本文研究非对称耗散下二阶非线性耦合双腔系统中的非常规光子阻塞，解析给出两族精确的最优阻塞条件，并发现 κ_B=2κ_A 的非对称耗散使阻塞条件对失谐免疫且阻塞深度提升一个量级。
AI.motivation: 以往二阶非线性双腔非常规光子阻塞研究多假设两腔耗散对称，耗散自由度未被充分利用；本文旨在考察将腔衰减率视为独立参数、引入非对称耗散后阻塞条件与单光子源品质如何变化。
AI.method: 以二阶非线性耦合双腔为模型，把两腔衰减率 κ_A、κ_B 作为独立参数进行解析推导，求解干涉路径相消的精确阻塞条件，得到两族解析解，并分析其对频率失谐的依赖、阻塞深度与平均光子数。
AI.result: 第一族条件回归并推广了对称耗散下的已有结果；第二族条件仅在 κ_B=2κ_A 的非对称耗散比下出现，可完全锁定干涉路径的相对相位。该非对称耗散使最优阻塞条件严格不受频率失谐影响，且阻塞深度比共振情形提升约一个数量级；同时平均光子数几乎不变。
AI.conclusion: 非对称耗散可作为一种有效调控手段，在不牺牲单光子源亮度的前提下实现抗失谐、更深的非常规光子阻塞，为无源二阶非线性腔中稳健的单光子产生提供可行途径。

title: Optimised 8th-Order Trotter-Suzuki Schemes for Quantum Simulation
summary: Simulating quantum dynamics in many-body systems is one of the most promising applications of quantum computers. Product formulas are a natural choice for this task, since they map directly onto quantum gates, and increasing their order $n$ could lead to reduced gate depths, provided the parameters are chosen efficiently. So far, schemes beyond $6^{\textrm{th}}$ order have only been built as compositions of second-order schemes, while more general product formulas are known only up to $6^{\textrm{th}}$ order. In this work, we extend our optimisation framework to order $n = 8$, and find both more efficient compositions and the first $8^{\textrm{th}}$ order general schemes. Our formulas improve on the theoretical efficiency of the state-of-the-art schemes by Morales et al and we recommend two schemes explicitly. In simulations of the Heisenberg XZ chain one of our recommended schemes always outperforms those by Morales et al, though it is not always the same scheme that performs best. More generally, we observe that for Hamiltonians split into many non-commuting operators the uniformity of a Trotter decomposition becomes the main indicator of a scheme's performance. To assess the schemes' use on quantum hardware, we simulate noisy circuits with our new Qiskit plugin qiskit-omelyan. At current noise levels, the Leapfrog scheme remains the best choice, but as noise rates decrease toward fault tolerance, our recommended schemes become competitive.

AI.tldr: 本文将乘积公式优化框架推广到8阶，构造出更高效的组合公式与首个8阶通用乘积公式，并在Heisenberg XZ链与含噪电路模拟中评估其性能。
AI.motivation: 多体量子动力学模拟是量子计算最有前景的应用之一，乘积公式可直接映射到量子门，提高阶数n有望降低门深度，但前提是参数选取高效。此前超过6阶的方案仅为二阶方案的组合，通用乘积公式也只到6阶，缺乏更高阶的通用高效方案。
AI.method: 将已有的优化框架扩展到n=8阶，搜索更高效的组合方案以及首个8阶通用（general）公式；理论上与Morales等人的最新方案比较效率；在Heisenberg XZ链上进行数值模拟，并以非对易算符数量较多的哈密顿量为对象分析均匀性对性能的影响；借助新开发的Qiskit插件qiskit-omelyan模拟含噪电路。
AI.result: 所得公式在理论效率上优于Morales等人的最新方案，并明确推荐两种方案；在Heisenberg XZ链模拟中，所推荐的一个方案始终优于Morales等人的方案，但最优方案并不固定；当哈密顿量被拆分为多个非对易算符时，Trotter分解的均匀性成为性能的主要指标；含噪模拟显示当前噪声水平下Leapfrog方案仍最优，而随着噪声率向容错阈值降低，所推荐方案变得具有竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 8阶乘积公式的优化构造可行且有效，可提升理论效率并给出实用推荐方案；方案选择依赖哈密顿量结构与噪声水平，均匀性是关键指标；在近期噪声条件下Leapfrog仍占优，而面向容错时新方案更具优势。

title: Stinespring's Dilation, Universal-NOT, and Limitations of Quantum Uncoupled Learning
summary: Uncoupled learning, in which players know only their own payoff, are a standard model of decentralized learning toward Nash equilibrium. We study their quantum counterpart, where strategies are quantum states and, in each round, a player receives a physical copy of their opponent's current strategy and updates their own state by a quantum channel. This adds to uncoupledness a constraint with no classical analogue: every update must be physically realizable. In fact, this constraint is decisive in conjugation games, in which Bob has a strictly dominant pure strategy and Alice's unique best response is its transpose. In this work, we show some limitations of uncoupled (learning) dynamics in finding the Nash equilibrium for conjugation games. First, we prove that no autonomous, memoryless, uncoupled dynamics converge to Nash equilibrium in a family of four single-qubit conjugation games. Specifically, any memoryless channel that keeps all four equilibria fixed will leave Alice's strategy frozen. This result also extends to $4^n$ games on $n$-qubit registers. Second, we show that this barrier disappears with a small classical memory: for any finite family of $L$ pure targets, a guess-and-test rule with $O(\log L)$ classical bits converges to equilibrium, with an explicit bound on its convergence rate. Finally, we prove that no finite memory, classical or quantum, suffices for the continuum of all pure-qubit targets. Our proof of the impossibility for memoryless channels relies on Stinespring's dilation theorem, while the impossibility for finite-memory channels relies on the optimal universal-NOT (in)fidelity bound by Bužek, Hillery, and Werner.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究"无耦合学习"的量子对应，证明在共轭博弈（conjugation games）中，无记忆量子通道的动态无法收敛到纳什均衡，但只要少量经典记忆（O(log L)比特）即可收敛；而对连续统纯量子比特目标，任何有限记忆（经典或量子）都不够。
AI.motivation: 经典无耦合学习（玩家仅知自身收益）是去中心化学习达到纳什均衡的标准模型。将其推广到量子情形后，除无耦合性外还存在经典中不存在的约束：每轮更新必须是物理上可实现的量子通道。该约束在共轭博弈中起决定性作用，因此需要刻画量子无耦合动态的收敛能力及其极限。
AI.method: 1）形式化量子无耦合动态：策略为量子态，玩家每轮获得对手当前策略的物理副本，并用量子通道更新自身状态；2）针对四个单量子比特共轭博弈族，证明任何保持全部四个均衡点不动的无记忆通道都会使Alice的策略冻结，从而无自主、无记忆、无耦合的动态收敛到纳什均衡，并将结果推广到n量子比特寄存器上的4^n个博弈；3）提出带O(log L)经典比特的"猜测-测试"（guess-and-test）规则，处理L个纯目标构成的有限族；4）证明对全部纯量子比特目标的连续统，任何有限记忆（经典或量子）均不充分。核心技术工具为Stinespring膨胀定理（无记忆不可能性）与Bužek–Hillery–Werner的最优通用NOT（不）保真度界（有限记忆不可能性）。
AI.result: （i）共轭博弈中不存在自主、无记忆、无耦合的量子动态收敛到纳什均衡；任何固定四个单量子比特均衡的无记忆通道会使Alice策略冻结，且该结论扩展到n量子比特上的4^n个博弈。（ii）加入O(log L)经典比特的猜测-测试规则可对任意L个纯目标的有限族收敛到均衡，并给出显式收敛速率界。（iii）对连续统纯量子比特目标，有限记忆（经典或量子）均不足以实现收敛。
AI.conclusion: 物理可实现性这一量子特有约束构成无记忆无耦合学习的根本障碍；少量经典记忆即可突破有限目标族的障碍，但对连续统目标集，有限记忆（无论经典还是量子）本质上不够。这揭示了量子去中心化学习的记忆—收敛权衡关系。

title: Pulse-tube-vibration induced Larmor frequency jitter in anisotropic Kramers spins
summary: We investigate the role of pulse-tube mechanical vibrations towards spin frequency noise in a cryogen-free dilution refrigerator. Our system comprises of a low mode-volume superconducting resonator coupled to 50 ppm $\text{Er}^{3+}:\text{CaWO}_4$ spins with highly anisotropic g-factors. By measuring single-shot spin echoes using narrow-bandwidth three-pulse sequences, we directly observe a vibration induced stochastic signal resulting from the spin's Larmor frequency moving into and out of the detection bandwidth. The sensitivity to these vibrations is substantially suppressed when a) the external magnetic field is aligned along the symmetry c-axis and b) spin temperature is modestly increased to 60~mK. We also benchmark the system as a quantum sensor for angular fluctuations, extracting a noise floor of 350 nanodegrees.

AI.tldr: 研究无制冷剂稀释制冷机中脉冲管制冷机机械振动对自旋频率噪声的影响，利用50 ppm Er³⁺:CaWO₄自旋与超导谐振腔耦合体系，通过窄带三脉冲单发自旋回波直接观测到振动引起的随机信号，并给出抑制方法与角向噪声基准。
AI.motivation: 无制冷剂（脉冲管）稀释制冷机中的机械振动可能引入自旋拉莫尔频率噪声，限制自旋量子器件与量子传感的相干性与测量保真度，需定量表征其影响机制。
AI.method: 构建低模体积超导谐振腔与50 ppm Er³⁺:CaWO₄（强各向异性g因子）自旋耦合体系；采用窄带宽三脉冲序列进行单发自旋回波测量，观测振动导致的随机信号——源于自旋拉莫尔频率进出探测带宽；对比不同磁场取向与自旋温度条件。
AI.result: 直接观测到脉冲管振动引起的随机信号；当外磁场沿对称c轴取向、且自旋温度略升至60 mK时，对振动的灵敏度显著被抑制；将体系作为角向涨落量子传感器，噪声本底达350纳度（350 nanodegrees）。
AI.conclusion: 脉冲管机械振动是无制冷剂稀释制冷机中自旋频率噪声的重要来源，可通过磁场沿c轴对准与适度提高自旋温度有效抑制；该体系亦可作为亚微度级角向涨落量子传感器。

title: Consecutive Supersymmetric Quantum Mechanical Algorithms for Resolving the Spectra of Legendre-type Differential Operators
summary: Quite comprehensive iterative algorithms based on consecutive supersymmetric quantum mechanics (SUSYQM) have been constructed heuristically, for resolving the eigenspectra of the Legendre operator and its associates parametrized in various coordinates, \emph{without receiving any input from traditional analytical methods}. On building these algorithms, the two symmetries \text{--} supersymmetry and shape invariance symmetry \text{--} hidden in these operators are brought to the fore as the only two governing principles, with the aids of the newly devised algebraic techniques such as the \emph{active supersymmetrization transformations}, \emph{momentum operator maps} as well as plain and \emph{higher-order spin matrix maps}. In view of their algebraic simplicity and elegance, high efficiency, as well as independence of traditional methods, some of these algorithms become the promising candidates to supplant the popular power series approach to the eigenspectra of Legendre-type operators.

AI.tldr: 基于连续超对称量子力学(SUSYQM)构造了求解Legendre算子及其关联算子本征谱的迭代算法，仅以超对称与形状不变性为基本原理，不依赖传统解析方法。
AI.motivation: 现有Legendre型算子本征谱求解依赖幂级数等传统解析方法；作者希望揭示算子中隐藏的超对称与形状不变性对称，并构建纯代数、可迭代的求解算法。
AI.method: 以连续SUSYQM为框架，将超对称与形状不变性作为唯一支配原理，结合新提出的代数技巧：主动超对称化变换、动量算子映射，以及普通与高阶自旋矩阵映射；算法以启发式方式构造，覆盖多坐标系参数化的Legendre算子及关联算子。
AI.result: 得到了一系列较为完备的迭代算法，可求解各类Legendre型算子的本征谱，且过程中不引入任何传统解析方法的输入。
AI.conclusion: 这些算法代数简洁优雅、效率高且独立于传统方法，部分算法有望取代常用的幂级数方法，成为Legendre型算子本征谱求解的新方案。

title: Emergent Causality of Macroscopic Transport and Equilibration in Long-Range Quantum Systems
summary: Long-range couplings in quantum many-body systems challenge conventional notions of locality and causality. Here, we show that macroscopic particle transport nevertheless exhibits emergent causality --- an effective light cone that becomes strict in the thermodynamic limit. For power-law hopping with a decay exponent $α\in(D,D+1)$ in $D$ spatial dimensions, the emergent causality cone expands super-ballistically, and we establish that its scaling is optimal. Our results imply lower bounds on the equilibration time of long-range systems. Finally, we construct an example of a long-range free-fermion chain with $α\in (1,3/2)$, whose macroscopic density equilibrates super-ballistically, i.e., in a time sub-linear in the system size. While long-range interactions are usually associated with slow equilibration due to increased energy barriers, our example demonstrates that long-range hopping can lead to accelerated equilibration.

AI.tldr: 长程跃迁量子多体系统中仍存在涌现因果性——一个在热力学极限下变得严格的有效光锥;对 $D$ 维、$\\alpha\\in(D,D+1)$ 的幂律跃迁,该涌现光锥呈超弹道式扩张且标度最优,并给出平衡时间的下界;进一步构造 $\\alpha\\in(1,3/2)$ 的长程自由费米子链,其宏观密度以亚线性于系统尺寸的时间超弹道式平衡。
AI.motivation: 长程耦合挑战传统的局域性与因果性观念,且通常被认为因能垒增大而导致缓慢平衡。作者希望厘清长程系统中宏观输运是否仍受某种因果结构约束,并检验长程跃迁对平衡时间的真实影响。
AI.method: 研究 $D$ 维空间中幂律跃迁(衰减指数 $\\alpha\\in(D,D+1)$)的量子多体系统;通过构造并证明宏观粒子输运所满足的涌现光锥(有效因果锥),确立其超弹道扩张标度的最优性,并据此推导平衡时间的下界;进而以长程自由费米子链($\\alpha\\in(1,3/2)$)为显式可解实例验证密度平衡行为。
AI.result: (1) 宏观粒子输运呈现涌现因果性,有效光锥在热力学极限下变严格;(2) 该光锥以超弹道速度扩张,且所给标度为最优;(3) 由此得到长程系统平衡时间的下界;(4) 构造出 $\\alpha\\in(1,3/2)$ 的自由费米子链,其宏观密度超弹道式平衡,时间亚线性于系统尺寸。
AI.conclusion: 长程系统并不放弃因果性,而是以"涌现光锥"的形式保留之;长程跃迁未必导致慢平衡,反而可能加速平衡,修正了"长程相互作用必然伴随缓慢平衡"的直觉。

title: Symplectic Matroids, Stabilizer Codes, and Quantum Secret-Sharing
summary: An $\mathbb{F}_q$-linear $[[n,k]]_q$ stabilizer code is represented by a totally isotropic subspace of $\mathbb{F}_q^{2n}$ of dimension $n-k$, whose full-rank generator matrix has nonzero maximal minors on admissible column sets forming the bases of a representable symplectic matroid. Sarvepalli asked whether graphical symplectic matroids introduced by Chow give stabilizer codes with good parameters, when a Lagrangian matroid induces a quantum access structure, which code realizes it, and which polynomial carries the weight enumerator. We answer these questions. For a $3$-connected simple graph, every representation of a graphical symplectic matroid, over any field, gives a stabilizer code of distance exactly $2$, so the girth is not a lower bound. For a represented Lagrangian matroid and a dealer, we construct the dealer-shortened stabilizer code, its logical operators, an encoding isometry and explicit recovery maps, and we show that this is the code implemented by the stabilizer state through teleportation. A set of players recovers the secret, learns nothing, or learns part of it according to a rank formula on pairs of columns, which equals its mutual information with the dealer; for graph states it becomes a cut-rank condition. Over $\F_2$ a symplectic matroid of any rank has only one representation, so the code, its access structure and its weight enumerators depend on the matroid alone; for $q\ge3$ even the enumerator does not. Circuit-induced authorized sets always reconstruct when the matroid is self-dual, but not in general, and a six-qubit graph state shows that the two access structures can differ even then. Finally, a polynomial in the ranks of column pairs determines both weight enumerators.

AI.tldr: 本文系统回答了Sarvepalli提出的关于图解辛拟阵(graphical symplectic matroid)与拉格朗日拟阵量子码的四个问题：3-连通简单图的任何表示只能给出距离恰为2的稳定子码；对给定dealer构造了dealer-shortened稳定子码、逻辑算子、编码等距与显式恢复映射，并证明访问结构可由列对秩公式刻画且等于与dealer的互信息；F_2上任意辛拟阵只有唯一表示，故码、访问结构与权重枚举子仅依赖拟阵本身；并给出列对秩多项式同时决定两个权重枚举子。
AI.motivation: Sarvepalli提出疑问：Chow引入的图解辛拟阵是否给出参数良好的稳定子码？拉格朗日拟阵何时诱导量子访问结构、由哪个码实现、由哪个多项式承载权重枚举子？本文旨在正面回答这些问题，并厘清拟阵表示与量子码参数、访问结构之间的关系。
AI.method: 运用F_q-线性稳定子码与全各向同性子空间、可表示辛拟阵的对应框架；在可表示拉格朗日拟阵与dealer模型下构造dealer-shortened稳定子码、其逻辑算子、编码等距及显式恢复映射，并与通过隐形传态实现的稳定子态码作比较；用列对上的秩公式刻画集合的恢复/零泄露/部分泄露；在F_2上分析辛拟阵表示的唯一性，并构造列对秩多项式以统一导出两个权重枚举子；辅以六量子比特图态反例。
AI.result: 对3-连通简单图，图解辛拟阵在任意域上的每个表示所给稳定子码距离恰为2，故围长(girth)不构成距离下界；访问结构的成员判定由列对秩公式给出，且等于与dealer的互信息，图态情形化为割秩条件；F_2上任意秩的辛拟阵仅有唯一表示，码、访问结构与权重枚举子仅由拟阵决定，q≥3时连枚举子也不唯一；拟阵自对偶时电路诱导的授权集总可重构，但一般情况下不成立，六量子比特图态显示即使在自对偶时两种访问结构仍可不同。
AI.conclusion: 图解辛拟阵的表示普遍只能给出距离为2的码，因此不构成获得良好参数码的途径；可表示拉格朗日拟阵在dealer框架下导出结构清晰、可显式重构的量子秘密共享码，其访问结构由列对秩（互信息）完全刻画；F_2上码与访问结构纯由拟阵决定，且存在一个列对秩多项式统一决定两种权重枚举子，为拟阵—量子码对应提供了代数刻画。

title: Trotter Error Bounds in Lean 4 with a Cancellation-Aware Analysis of the Fourth-Order Suzuki Formula
comment: 44 pages, 1 figure. Computational supplement and Lean provenance files included as ancillary material
summary:
We formalize the commutator-scaling bound of Childs et al. in Lean 4. For skew-adjoint generators, the local order condition gives an explicit integer step count sufficient to meet a prescribed error tolerance. We apply the theorem in Lean to the binary fourth-order Suzuki formula. For this formula we can also account for cancellation within and between steps. Using local remainder estimates of Casas and Murua, we sum the signed quintic and centered seventh-degree error terms after conjugating each to the interaction picture. For every positive integer step count, we bound the difference between this sum and the global error operator. At fixed time the explicit remainder is eighth order in the step size, and the integral of the conjugated quintic term gives the exact leading error coefficient. The Lean proofs cover the two-generator finite-sum estimates, including the spectral norm for complex matrices.
  On five ten-site nearest-neighbor Heisenberg instances at time $10$ and tolerance $10^{-3}$, the transported sum meets the tolerance at a mean of $129.4$ steps. Taking a separate norm at each step with the same polynomial and remainder gives a mean first crossing between $184.6$ and $185.2$ steps. The accumulated Casas--Murua local bound at $q=8$ gives a mean of $184.8$ steps.

AI.tldr: 在Lean 4中形式化了Childs等的对易子标度界，并将其应用于二进制四阶Suzuki公式，借助Casas–Murua局部余项估计得到八阶余项与精确首阶误差系数，数值上大幅收紧步数估计。
AI.motivation: 严格（机器可验证）地刻画高阶乘积公式的误差上界：原始对易子标度界只给出充分步数，忽略了步内与步间的误差抵消，导致步数估计偏保守，需给出更紧且可形式化验证的误差控制。
AI.method: 用Lean 4形式化Childs等人的对易子标度界：对反自伴生成元，由局部阶条件给出满足给定误差容限的显式整数步数；将该定理应用于二进制四阶Suzuki公式；采用Casas–Murua局部余项估计，将各步共轭至相互作用表象后求和带符号五次项与中心七次误差项；对任意正整数步数界定该和与全局误差算子之差，并形式化验证双生成元有限和估计（含复矩阵谱范数）。
AI.result: 固定时间下显式余项为步长的八阶；共轭五次项的积分给出精确首阶误差系数。五个十格点最近邻Heisenberg实例（时间10、容限1e-3）：输运求和平均129.4步达标；逐步取范数的多项式与余项方法平均首次穿越184.6–185.2步；q=8的累积Casas–Murua局部界平均184.8步。
AI.conclusion: 考虑步内与步间抵消的共轭传输求和显著收紧步数估计（约129步 vs 约185步），且误差渐近系数精确，全部关键界均在Lean中机器验证。

title: Autonomous quantum machine learning via Riemannian gradient-based optimization
summary: Quantum machine learning models typically rely on repeated quantum measurements and classical optimization during training, making the quantum-to-classical information-extraction process a fundamental bottleneck for scalability. We propose a framework for autonomous self-training quantum machine learning, based on Riemannian gradient optimization, in which the optimization proceeds entirely within the quantum domain without requiring quantum measurements or classical feedback. We derive the Riemannian gradient update rules for a broad class of learning tasks and identify sufficient conditions under which the resulting training dynamics can be realized fully autonomously. Within this regime, we establish an exponential convergence guarantee, in the training iterations, for sufficiently small step sizes, and further analyze the training cost in terms of the growth of the circuit depth. Importantly, we further show that the trained model can automatically discover symmetries hidden in the training data without $\textit{a priori}$ specification. For the canonical examples of quantum phase classification and unitary learning with a hidden symmetry, our numerical study indicates that learning can be achieved at low circuit depths with only a few distinct training examples. Our results thus establish autonomous quantum machine learning as a promising paradigm that removes the classical optimization loop while retaining strong theoretical guarantees and practical performances.

AI.tldr: 提出基于黎曼梯度优化的自主自训练量子机器学习框架，优化全程在量子域内完成，无需量子测量与经典反馈，并给出指数收敛保证与电路深度成本分析。
AI.motivation: 量子机器学习模型通常依赖重复量子测量与经典优化，量子到经典的信息提取过程成为可扩展性的根本瓶颈。
AI.method: 构建基于黎曼梯度优化的自主自训练框架；推导一类广泛学习任务的黎曼梯度更新规则，给出训练动力学可完全自主实现的充分条件。
AI.result: 在足够小步长下建立了随训练迭代的指数收敛保证；分析了以电路深度增长衡量的训练成本；模型可自动发现训练数据中隐藏的对称性而无需先验指定；在量子相位分类与含隐藏对称性的酉学习数值实验中，以低电路深度和少量不同训练样本即实现学习。
AI.conclusion: 自主量子机器学习去除了经典优化回路，同时保持强理论保证与实用性能，是一种有前景的新范式。

title: Structure-preserving compression of Matrix Product States
summary: Matrix product state time evolution relies on compression to control the growth of bond dimensions, but compression can break the conservation laws of the equation being solved. A truncation is not the flow of a Hermitian generator, so even a small truncation error can violate exact algebraic identities of the Schrödinger equation. For any matrix product state integrator that leaves the state in canonical form with an orthogonality center, a scalar correction restores an admissible global invariant after compression whenever the resulting scalar quadratic constraint equation admits a real root, without enlarging any bond dimension. Rank-preserving recovery searches other canonical centers when that correction fails. The geometry of the low-rank manifold provides sufficient conditions for conservation by the fixed-rank projected flow and bounds what corrections within a frozen center frame can achieve. Numerical experiments demonstrate that recovery can be required even along accurate truncated trajectories.

AI.tldr: 针对MPS时间演化中压缩破坏守恒律的问题，提出不增大键维数的标量修正与保秩恢复方案，并给出低秩流形几何下的守恒充分条件。
AI.motivation: MPS时间演化依赖压缩来控制键维数增长，但截断并非Hermitian生成元的流，即使很小的截断误差也会破坏薛定谔方程的精确代数恒等式（守恒量）。
AI.method: 对任意将态保持为带正交性中心的正则形式的MPS积分器：压缩后引入标量修正，在标量二次约束方程存在实根时恢复可容许的全局不变量，且不增大任何键维数；若该修正失败，则采用保秩恢复，在其他正则中心间搜索。同时利用低秩流形几何给出固定秩投影流守恒的充分条件，并界定冻结中心框架内修正所能达到的界限。
AI.result: 给出标量修正的可解性条件（二次约束有实根）与保秩恢复策略；由流形几何导出守恒的充分条件及冻结中心框架下修正能力的界；数值实验表明即使在精确的截断轨迹上也可能需要恢复操作。
AI.conclusion: 以极小代价（不增键维、仅标量自由度）即可在压缩后严格恢复全局不变量，为MPS时间演化积分器提供了一种保持守恒律的通用后处理机制。

title: Explicit construction of the normal cone at every nonlocal extreme behaviour of $\mathcal{Q}_{2222}$ and device-independent applications
summary: The set of quantum correlations $\mathcal{Q}_{2222}$, in the simplest Bell scenario with two parties performing two binary measurements each, is an object of fundamental interest both in quantum foundations and for device-independent applications. A nonlocal extremal quantum behaviour in this set can maximize many different Bell expressions, yet these expressions are not all equally useful in a practical experiment. Here, firstly, we give an explicit characterization of every Bell expression maximized by any given nonlocal extremal quantum behaviour in this Bell scenario. This determines the full normal cone at every such behaviour and makes it possible to optimize over all Bell tests with the same ideal behavior. We then derive an exact variational formula for the quantum bound of an arbitrary Bell expression in this scenario. As an example illustrating the construction, we derive the normal cone for a family of extremal quantum behaviours of importance in device-independent randomness certification, from Phys. Rev. Lett. 129, 150403, 2022. Finally, we explore the consequences of this characterization for device-independent randomness generation in practical experiments. Specifically, for any given detection efficiency $η\in [0.75,0.98]$, we construct Bell tests and two-qubit experiments that certify more single-round min-entropy from one Bell score than any CHSH score can certify with the same detector efficiency, even when the quantum devices used for the CHSH test are optimized. The results provide a systematic way to choose Bell tests for a desired quantum behaviour and to improve their performance for device-independent applications under experimental imperfections.

AI.tldr: 本文显式刻画了Q2222中每个非局域极值量子行为所最大化的全部Bell表达式（即法锥），给出任意Bell表达式量子界的精确变分公式，并构造在检测效率η∈[0.75,0.98]下比CHSH更优的Bell检验用于设备无关随机性生成。
AI.motivation: 在二方二输入二输出（2222）Bell场景中，非局域极值量子行为可同时最大化多个Bell表达式，但这些表达式在实际实验中的实用性并不相同；需要一个系统工具来刻画同一理想行为对应的全部Bell检验，并在实验不完美条件下选择更优的Bell检验。
AI.method: 以量子关联集Q2222的几何结构为基础，显式刻画每个非局域极值行为处的法锥（即其所最大化的所有Bell表达式），得到完整法锥；进而推导该场景下任意Bell表达式量子界的精确变分公式；并将该构造应用于Phys. Rev. Lett. 129, 150403 (2022)中的一类极值量子行为，计算其法锥。
AI.result: 给出每个非局域极值行为的完整法锥刻画及任意Bell表达式量子界的精确变分公式；针对检测效率η∈[0.75,0.98]，构造Bell检验与两比特实验，使单个Bell分数所证明的单轮min-entropy超过任何CHSH分数（即使CHSH所用量子器件经优化）在相同探测效率下所能证明的量。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提供了为期望量子行为系统选择Bell检验的方法，并可在实验不完美条件下提升设备无关随机性生成等应用的表现。

title: The inverted harmonic oscillator in Segal-Bargmann space: Time-asymmetric propagator reconstruction and bi-coherent states
summary: We investigate the real-time dynamics and resonance quantization of the inverted harmonic oscillator (IHO). Its self-adjoint Hamiltonian on $L^2(\mathbb{R})$ has a real continuous spectrum, while generalized resonance states outside $L^2(\mathbb{R})$ have purely imaginary energies $\pm i\hbarω(n+1/2)$. In coordinate space, these states are expressed in terms of complex Hermite polynomials and are biorthonormal under the Fresnel Gaussian pairing. Adapting Moriconi's coordinate-time transformation to the real-time path integral, we derive the exact Feynman propagator. Using Mehler's formula, we show that each discrete expansion alone reconstructs the full unitary kernel on its time half-axis, with the decaying Gamow-Siegert branch converging for $T>0$ and the growing antiresonant branch converging for $T<0$. In the complex-scaled Segal-Bargmann representation, the two Hamiltonians take the form $\pm i\hbarω(z(d/dz)+1/2)$, and their monomial eigenfunctions map back to the dual complex Hermite states. The two convergence domains correspond to one-sided contraction semigroups of dilations. Finally, we construct bi-coherent states whose biorthogonal position and momentum second cumulants are purely imaginary and complex conjugate, with product $\hbar^2/4$. The corresponding Heisenberg expectation values follow the exact classical hyperbolic trajectories for arbitrary real initial positions and momenta.

AI.tldr: 研究倒谐振子(IHO)的实时动力学与共振量子化：证明其共振态与对偶态构成双正交体系，给出精确Feynman传播子，并阐明两条收敛分支分别对应T>0与T<0的单侧收缩半群，最后构造双相干态并证明其Heisenberg期望值沿经典双曲轨迹演化。
AI.motivation: IHO的Hamiltonian自伴且谱为实连续，但其推广共振态具有纯虚能量±iℏω(n+1/2)，存在"实谱与复共振能量"的张力；同时实时间路径积分下共振分支的发散/收敛行为及双正交结构缺乏统一、严格的表述。
AI.method: 1) 在坐标空间用复Hermite多项式表示共振态与对偶态，并以Fresnel高斯配对建立双正交性；2) 将Moriconi坐标-时间变换推广到实时间路径积分，求得精确Feynman传播子；3) 借助Mehler公式证明单一离散展开即可在其时间半轴上重构完整酉核；4) 在复标度Segal-Bargmann表示中把两个Hamiltonian化为±iℏω(z d/dz+1/2)，用单项式本征函数与伸缩单侧收缩半群解释收敛域；5) 构造双相干态并计算双正交位置/动量二阶累积量及Heisenberg期望值。
AI.result: 共振态能量为±iℏω(n+1/2)，在Fresnel高斯配对下双正交；得到精确Feynman传播子；衰减的Gamow-Siegert分支在T>0收敛、增长的反对共振分支在T<0收敛，且各自单独重构完整酉核；Segal-Bargmann表示中本征函数为单项式并映回对偶复Hermite态；双相干态的两组二阶累积量纯虚且互为复共轭，乘积为ℏ²/4，Heisenberg期望值对任意实初值严格遵循经典双曲轨迹。
AI.conclusion: IHO的复共振结构可在严格的双正交与半群框架下自洽描述：实时传播子由单侧收敛的离散展开完整重构，复标度表示揭示其本质为伸缩半群；双相干态给出最小不确定度（复形式）且精确复现经典双曲运动，为开放/非自伴量子系统的共振量子化提供范例。

title: Practical insights into controlling exponential concentration in quantum machine learning
summary: Quantum Machine Learning (QML) models are often limited by exponential concentration, where quantum observables become insensitive to input variations as system size increases. In this work, we provide a comparative empirical study of this phenomenon across Fidelity Quantum Kernels (FQK), Projected Quantum Kernels (PQK), and Quantum Extreme Learning (QEL), within a unified observable-based framework based on expectation-value variance. We investigate how measurement locality, entanglement, and circuit expressivity shape concentration across different architectures. Global fidelity-based kernels exhibit strong concentration driven by Hilbert space dimensionality, whereas local-observable approaches reduce but do not eliminate this effect. In PQK and QEL, concentration is primarily governed by entanglement and quantum dynamical expressivity, with reservoir depth emerging as a key factor in QEL architectures. We further study bandwidth scaling as a general mechanism for controlling encoding expressivity across all models. Our results indicate that bandwidth scaling effectively reduces concentration in moderate regimes by restricting the effective expressivity of the encoding, though this protective effect diminishes in highly expressive structural settings.

AI.tldr: 本文在统一的基于期望值方差的观测框架下，对FQK、PQK与QEL三类量子机器学习模型的指数集中现象进行了比较实证研究，揭示测量局域性、纠缠与电路表达力如何塑造集中，并评估带宽缩放作为通用缓解机制的有效性与边界。
AI.motivation: 量子机器学习模型随系统规模增大常出现指数集中（可观测值对输入变化不敏感）问题，制约其可训练性与泛化能力。现有认识分散于不同模型，缺乏在统一可观测量框架下的横向比较，也不清楚不同结构因素（测量局域性、纠缠、表达力）各自的贡献。
AI.method: 构建以期望值方差为核心度量的统一可观测量框架，将FQK、PQK与QEL纳入同一分析口径；通过数值实证比较三类架构中集中现象的表现，分别考察测量局域性、纠缠程度与电路/动力学表达力的影响，并系统研究带宽缩放（bandwidth scaling）在各类模型中对编码表达力的调控作用。
AI.result: 全局保真度型核的集中由希尔伯特空间维度主导且强度显著；局域可观测量方案可削弱但不能消除集中。在PQK与QEL中，集中主要由纠缠与量子动力学表达力决定，QEL中储池深度是关键因素。带宽缩放在中等区间可通过限制编码的有效表达力有效缓解集中，但在高表达力结构配置下这种保护效应减弱。
AI.conclusion: 指数集中并非单一因素所致，而是测量局域性、纠缠与表达力共同作用的架构依赖现象；带宽缩放是一种通用但有限的调控手段，仅在适度表达力区间有效。研究为QML模型设计中在表达力与可训练性之间取得平衡提供了统一的经验依据。

title: Classical simulability and hardware diagnostics for QAOA on geographic coverage benchmarks
summary: Quantum-optimization benchmarks can show reduced energy while concealing local loss of weighted covariance. We combine encoding checks with exact structural references to select informative circuit diagnostics for static geographic coverage instances. The executed 24-qubit surrogate has infeasible ground states, whereas a faithful 51-qubit slack encoding preserves its 13 support-graph components and remains exactly simulable blockwise. At the executed angles, the total ideal optimum probability is $5.47\times10^{-20}$, making optimum counts uninformative at the executed budget of $10^5$ shots. A product distribution with the measured bit marginals accounts for about $90\%$ of the observed energy reduction. In three fixed-circuit jobs, the global weighted-covariance ratio is approximately $0.50$, while a five-variable block has ratios between $0.12$ and $0.28$ and contributes only $3.7\%$ of the ideal global denominator. Simultaneous bands resolve its deficit relative to the global ratio under an exploratory conditional counting model. The exact block reference thus reveals a local discrepancy concealed by the aggregate, without identifying an error mechanism or establishing device stability. The procedure links benchmark structure to the resolution and limitations of its observables.

AI.tldr: 该文用编码校验与精确结构参照检验量子优化基准的可解释性：执行层面的24比特替代模型存在不可行基态，而忠实的51比特松弛编码可保持13个支撑图分量并逐块精确模拟；在10^5次采样下最优概率仅5.47e-20，最优计数无信息量，约90%的能量下降可由测量比特边缘的乘积分布解释；三个固定线路任务全局加权协方差比约0.50，但一个五变量块的比值仅0.12–0.28且只占理想全局分母的3.7%，表明聚合指标掩盖了局部亏损。
AI.motivation: 量子优化基准常报告能量下降，却可能掩盖局部可观测量（如加权协方差）的损失；作者希望建立一套能把基准结构与可观测量的分辨能力、局限性对应起来的诊断流程，从而识别"整体看似改善、局部实际亏损"的隐藏差异。
AI.method: 以静态地理覆盖实例为对象：先做编码校验，建立忠实的高比特（51-qubit）松弛编码作为精确结构参照，并利用其13个支撑图分量实现分块精确模拟；同时分析执行层面的24-qubit替代模型。在10^5 shots预算下评估理想最优概率与最优计数信息量，构造匹配实测比特边缘的乘积分布做能量分解，并在三个固定线路任务中按变量块（含一个五变量块）计算加权协方差比并与理想全局分母对比，辅以条件计数模型下的同时置信带。
AI.result: 24-qubit替代模型存在不可行基态；51-qubit编码保持13个支撑图分量且可逐块精确模拟。执行角度下理想最优概率总量为5.47×10^-20，10^5 shots下最优计数不可用。乘积分布解释约90%的观测能量下降。三个固定线路任务全局加权协方差比约0.50，而五变量块比值在0.12–0.28之间、仅贡献理想全局分母的3.7%；同时置信带在该探索性条件计数模型下显示出该块相对全局比值的亏损。
AI.conclusion: 精确的块级参照揭示了聚合指标所掩盖的局部不一致，但未识别具体错误机制，也未确立器件稳定性；该流程的价值在于把基准结构与可观测量可达到的分辨率及其局限显式对应起来。

title: Actively stabilized Fabry-Pérot notch filters for correlated photons from cold two-level atoms
summary: We report two actively stabilized Fabry-Pérot cavities operated as reflection-mode notch filters for biphotons generated by spontaneous four-wave mixing in a cold two-level atomic ensemble. In this source, elastic scattering at the excitation frequency increases the single-detector count rates and the accidental-coincidence background, thereby limiting the observed nonclassical correlations. One cavity is placed in each photon-collection mode. An acousto-optic modulator frequency-dithers an auxiliary field, and synchronous demodulation of the transmitted power provides the locking discriminator. Light resonant with the auxiliary field is transmitted, whereas the detuned components are reflected toward the photon detectors. By tuning the auxiliary field to the same frequency as the excitation field, we filter these components and direct a larger portion of the quantum-correlated sidebands to the detection. The cavities have linewidths of approximately 2 MHz and remain locked for longer than a typical correlation acquisition. The measured Cauchy-Schwarz parameter exceeds unity in both configurations, with a higher central value with filtering ($\overline{R} = 4.15 \pm 0.93$) than without ($\overline{R} = 2.33 \pm 0.20$). This architecture provides actively stabilized rejection of a narrow spectral interval, simultaneously, for two fields detected in different directions. Filter performance could be further improved by adjusting the cavity linewidth to better match the spectral width of the central component and by reducing losses in the filters.

AI.tldr: 本文报道两台主动锁定法布里-珀罗腔，作为反射式陷波滤波器，用于滤除冷原子系综四波混频产生的双光子源中与激发场同频的弹性散射成分，从而提升非经典关联的观测质量。
AI.motivation: 在冷二能级原子系综自发四波混频双光子源中，激发频率处的弹性散射会抬高单探测器计数率与偶然符合本底，从而限制已观测到的非经典关联（Cauchy–Schwarz参数）。因此需要在两个光子收集模式中同时抑制该窄带成分。
AI.method: 在两路光子收集光路中各放置一台法布里-珀罗腔，以反射方式工作为陷波滤波器；利用声光调制器对辅助光场进行频率抖动，并对透射功率做同步解调以获得锁定鉴频信号，实现腔的主动稳频。将辅助场调至与激发场同频，则该频率光被透射（被丢弃），失谐的量子关联边带被反射并导向探测器。腔线宽约2 MHz，锁定时间超过典型关联采集时间。
AI.result: 两种配置下测得的Cauchy–Schwarz参数均超过1；加滤波时中心值为 R̄ = 4.15 ± 0.93，未滤波时为 R̄ = 2.33 ± 0.20，显示滤波后非经典关联的中心值提高。
AI.conclusion: 该架构可同时对两个不同传播方向的探测场实现主动稳定的窄带抑制。通过使腔线宽更好地匹配中心成分的谱宽并降低滤波器损耗，滤波性能可进一步提升。

title: Communication advantages of a quantum switch of two pure-loss channels
summary: The quantum switch can enable communication through otherwise unusable channels, a phenomenon known as causal activation. We show that a switch of two identical pure-loss channels can achieve strictly greater energy-constrained classical and quantum capacities than their sequential use, even when two-way classical communication is available. Remarkably, the switch also activates quantum communication over a range of transmissivities for which the sequential channel has zero quantum capacity.

AI.tldr: 量子开关对两个相同的纯损耗信道进行切换，能在能量约束下实现比顺序使用（即使允许双向经典通信）严格更大的经典与量子容量，并在顺序信道量子容量为零的透射率区间激活量子通信。
AI.motivation: 利用量子开关实现"因果激活"（causal activation），使原本不可用的信道变得可用；本文旨在检验：即使允许双向经典通信这一最强辅助条件下，量子开关是否仍能带来超越顺序使用的容量增益。
AI.method: 以两个相同的纯损耗（pure-loss）信道为对象，比较其"量子开关切换"与"顺序使用"两种配置，在能量约束下分析经典容量与量子容量，并引入双向经典通信作为对照条件。
AI.result: 量子开关配置在能量约束下的经典容量与量子容量均严格大于顺序使用方案（即便存在双向经典通信）；此外，在顺序信道量子容量为零的一段透射率范围内，量子开关仍能激活量子通信。
AI.conclusion: 量子开关对纯损耗信道具有实质性、不可由经典协调替代的容量增益，可将零量子容量的信道区间转化为可用资源，凸显因果结构作为量子通信资源的独特价值。

title: Block Search Conditioned on Features for Sequential Quantum Data Encoding
comment: 6 pages, 1 figure. Prepared for ESANN 2027. Code and reproduction scripts: https://github.com/CeciliaBotelho/ESANN-2026
summary: Sequential quantum data encoding is addressed through the joint selection of input features and encoding blocks within a fixed quantum register. At each step, a new feature, a block of operations, its placement, and its rotation weights are selected together from training data, extending the incremental construction of Q-FLAIR. With direct-loss selection (RAW), nine to twelve features were retained in four qubits across five new Bars and Stripes datasets. Under the same final calibration, mean changes relative to the calibrated Q-FLAIR reference were +5.53 percentage points in balanced accuracy, -15.83% in binary cross-entropy (BCE), and +7.79% in area under the ROC curve (AUC). The prespecified success criterion was met in four of five datasets and for the mean paired differences. These results were obtained by comparing complete procedures under a common cap of 32 operations.

AI.tldr: 提出序列式量子数据编码方法：在固定量子寄存器上联合选择输入特征与编码块，以直接损失（RAW）准则增量构建Q-FLAIR，并在五个Bars and Stripes数据集上验证其优于校准参考。
AI.motivation: Q-FLAIR的增量构建中，特征选择与编码块（含操作、位置、旋转权重）通常分离处理，缺乏从训练数据中联合优化的机制，导致编码方案次优。
AI.method: 在固定量子寄存器上逐步进行序列式编码：每一步同时从训练数据中选择新特征、一个操作块、其放置位置及旋转权重，以直接损失（RAW）准则进行选择，从而扩展Q-FLAIR的增量构建；在32个操作的总量上限下，以校准后的Q-FLAIR为参考进行完整流程对比。
AI.result: 五个新Bars and Stripes数据集上，4量子比特内保留9–12个特征；相同最终校准下，相对参考平均变化为：平衡准确率+5.53个百分点，BCE下降15.83%，AUC提升7.79%。五个数据集中有四个及平均配对差异均满足预设成功标准。
AI.conclusion: 特征与编码块的联合、序列式直接损失选择可有效提升量子数据编码的性能，且结果在多数数据集和配对均值上达到预设成功判据。

title: Criterion and Construction Framework for Impure Quantum $(r,δ)$-LRCs from Optimal $(r,δ)$-LRCs
summary: This paper aims to uncover new phenomena and provide new tools for quantum \((r,δ)\)-LRCs derived from optimal \((r,δ)\)-LRCs. The initial motivation is to identify the main reason for the existence of impure cases in such quantum codes. Our main result reveals that whether \(d = r+1\) is the key factor governing the impurity of quantum \((r,δ)\)-LRCs. We prove that, when \(d \neq r+1\), impure quantum codes derived from optimal \((r,δ)\)-LRCs have bounded lengths. Conversely, when \(d = r+1\), we construct impure quantum \((r,δ)\)-LRCs with unbounded lengths. The central tool developed in this work is a criterion for identifying impure quantum codes derived from optimal \((r,δ)\)-LRCs. The main results include a criterion for impurity in quantum \((r,δ)\)-LRCs (Theorem 3.2), a construction framework for impure quantum \((r,δ)\)-LRCs (Theorem 4.4), and two families of impure quantum \((r,δ)\)-LRCs (Theorems 4.8 and 4.11).

AI.tldr: 本文揭示 \(d=r+1\) 是决定由最优 \((r,\delta)\)-LRC 构造的量子 \((r,\delta)\)-LRC 是否"不纯"（impure）的关键因素，并给出杂质判定准则与构造框架。
AI.motivation: 由最优 \((r,\delta)\)-LRC 构造量子 \((r,\delta)\)-LRC 时会出现 impure 情形，但此前不清楚其存在的主因，理论上缺乏刻画这一现象的判据与工具。
AI.method: 建立判定量子 \((r,\delta)\)-LRC 是否为 impure 的准则（定理3.2）；给出 impure 量子 \((r,\delta)\)-LRC 的构造框架（定理4.4），并据以构造两族 impure 码（定理4.8、4.11）；按 \(d\) 与 \(r+1\) 是否相等分成两种情形分析长度是否有界。
AI.result: 证明了核心二分结论：当 \(d\neq r+1\) 时，由最优 \((r,\delta)\)-LRC 导出的 impure 量子码长度有界；当 \(d=r+1\) 时，可构造出长度无界的 impure 量子 \((r,\delta)\)-LRC。同时得到两族显式的 impure 量子 \((r,\delta)\)-LRC。
AI.conclusion: \(d=r+1\) 是控制量子 \((r,\delta)\)-LRC 不纯性的关键条件，impurity 判据与构造框架为后续研究提供了通用工具，并说明在 \(d=r+1\) 情形下 impure 码可无限延展。

title: Quantum control of an electrically levitated nanoparticle with a trapped ion
summary: Quantum control of levitated nanoparticles offers a route towards macroscopic quantum states. Here we propose a novel way to achieve it for a nanoparticle levitated electrically in a linear Paul trap together with a single ion, a system recently realized experimentally. By suitably engineering the trap's AC potential, one can parametrically modulate the ion-nanoparticle distance and thus the Coulomb coupling to enable a resonant interaction. For realistic parameters, we calculate that this enables sympathetic cooling of the nanoparticle to its motional ground state by a single, continuously laser-cooled ion. Additional AC drives enable the preparation of squeezed nanoparticle states and of ion-nanoparticle entanglement. Moreover, non-Gaussian states such as Fock and cat states, prepared in the ion with standard trapped-ion techniques, can be transferred to the nanoparticle with high fidelities. We provide complete protocols for each of these states, including all known decoherence sources. Our results establish electrically trapped ion-nanoparticle systems as a platform for quantum control of levitated matter.

AI.tldr: 通过在离子阱中对AC势进行参数化调控来周期性调制离子-纳米颗粒距离与库仑耦合，从而在电悬浮离子-纳米颗粒混合系统中实现共振相互作用，完成基态冷却、压缩态、纠缠及非高斯态转移。
AI.motivation: 悬浮纳米颗粒是通向宏观量子态的重要途径，但电悬浮体系中难以实现颗粒与单一离子的有效耦合与共振相互作用，缺乏可操作的量子控制协议。
AI.method: 研究对象为线性Paul阱中电悬浮的纳米颗粒与单个离子的混合系统；通过工程设计阱的AC电势，对离子-纳米颗粒间距进行参数调制，进而调制库仑耦合以实现共振相互作用；附加AC驱动用于制备压缩态与纠缠；并借助标准离子阱技术将离子中的Fock态、猫态等非高斯态转移至纳米颗粒，给出包含全部已知退相干源的完整协议。
AI.result: 在现实参数下，仅靠单个连续激光冷却的离子即可将纳米颗粒协同冷却至运动基态；附加驱动可实现压缩态制备与离子-纳米颗粒纠缠；Fock态与猫态可高保真度转移至纳米颗粒。
AI.conclusion: 电悬浮离子-纳米颗粒系统可作为悬浮物质量子控制的通用平台。

title: Quadratic unconstrained binary optimization benchmark problems from mixed Hamming packings
comment: 36 pages, 4 figures, 'Online resource 1' included at the end of the paper
summary: Benchmarking exact solvers and noisy intermediate-scale quantum devices for quadratic unconstrained binary optimization (QUBO) requires small yet challenging instances, preferably coming from actual applications. We propose such a benchmark set derived from mixed Hamming packing, a hard problem in coding theory. Starting from its mixed-integer linear programming formulation, we provide a generator for the equivalent QUBO models and study 133 instances whose optima are certified by that formulation. In the feature space of the MQLib library, we position a broad range of existing quantum-oriented benchmarks relative to the classical ones: they lie along a narrow, sparse border of the region covered by MQLib, whereas our instances form a coherent family in a region that both collections leave almost empty. Classical heuristics and a simulated bifurcation machine find the optimum of most instances quickly, in several cases sooner than an exact mixed-integer solver first encounters it, suggesting heuristic warm starts for exact solvers; for an exact QUBO solver, in turn, it appears challenging to prove optimality. In Ising form, the instances are densely connected antiferromagnets whose large local fields are almost exactly balanced by the couplings, so that the decision on each variable rests on a small remainder. This makes them hard to embed and to represent accurately on current quantum annealers, in line with our D-Wave experiments.

AI.tldr: 作者从编码理论中的混合Hamming填充问题出发，构造了一组源自实际应用、小而难的QUBO基准实例，并用MILP验证了133个实例的最优值，从而填补了现有量子导向基准与经典基准之间的空白区域。
AI.motivation: 评测精确求解器与NISQ设备求解QUBO需要小而难、且最好来自真实应用的实例；现有基准明显不足。
AI.method: 基于混合Hamming填充问题的混合整数线性规划（MILP）形式，给出等价QUBO模型的生成器，并借助MILP认证133个实例的最优值；在MQLib的特征空间中定位现有量子基准与本文实例；比较经典启发式、模拟分岔机与精确MILP求解器的表现，并进行D-Wave实验。
AI.result: 现有量子导向基准集中在MQLib覆盖区域一条狭窄稀疏的边界上，而本文实例构成该空白区域中一个连贯的族；经典启发式与模拟分岔机可快速找到多数实例的最优解，有时早于精确MILP求解器首次遇到最优解；但对精确QUBO求解器而言证明最优性仍具挑战。Ising形式为稠密连接的反铁磁体，大局部场与耦合几乎精确抵消，决策依赖微小残差，导致难以嵌入并难以在当前量子退火机上精确表示，与D-Wave实验结果一致。
AI.conclusion: 该基准集兼具有应用来源、最优值可认证与结构困难等优点，可作为QUBO精确求解器和量子硬件的标准测试平台，并提示可用启发式热启动精确求解器。

title: Ancilla-Free Exact Dicke-State Synthesis with Optimal Size and Depth
summary: We construct exact circuits for $n$-qubit Dicke states of any Hamming weight $k$ using $O(n)$ single-qubit gates and CNOTs in $O(\log n)$ depth without ancillary qubits. The gate count and depth are asymptotically optimal for every $0<k<n$. We compress symmetric blocks to free output qubits for weight-dependent phases. A sign correction followed by a collective rotation produces a state whose overlap with the target is at least a positive constant, so exact amplitude amplification takes $O(1)$ steps. For balanced Dicke states ($k=\lfloor n/2\rfloor$), the logarithmic depth disproves the $Ω(k)$ depth lower bound conjectured by Yuan and Zhang (2025).

AI.tldr: 该论文给出构造任意Hamming权重k的n量子比特Dicke态的精确线路：仅用O(n)个单比特门与CNOT、深度O(log n)、无需辅助比特，门数与深度对每个0<k<n均渐近最优，并推翻Yuan-Zhang(2025)关于Ω(k)深度下界的猜想。
AI.motivation: 现有Dicke态制备方案在门数、深度或辅助比特开销上非最优，且存在Ω(k)深度下界猜想；作者希望实现同时达到渐近最优门数与对数深度、且无辅助比特的精确制备。
AI.method: 利用对称块的压缩释放输出比特以承载依赖权重的相位；先做符号校正，再做一次集体旋转，使所得态与目标态重叠度不低于某个正常数，从而以O(1)步精确振幅放大收尾。
AI.result: 对任意权重k的n比特Dicke态，实现O(n)单比特门与CNOT、O(log n)深度、零辅助比特的精确线路；门数与深度渐近最优；平衡态(k=⌊n/2⌋)情形下对数深度与猜想下界矛盾。
AI.conclusion: Dicke态制备的门数与深度可同时达到渐近最优，且平衡Dicke态的O(log n)深度否定了Ω(k)深度下界猜想，修正了该领域的复杂度认识。

title: Detection of genuine multipartite entanglement by means of entanglement monotones
summary: We look for pure state entanglement monotones that may serve as certificates of a strong form of genuine multipartite entanglement, that we refer to as irreducible entanglement: a $D$-partite state (with $D\geq 3$) is irreducibly $D$-partite entangled if it cannot be decomposed as a product of states that are at most $(D-1)$-partite entangled. We start by establishing a no-go result proving that no reasonable genuine multipartite entanglement entropy can simultaneously obey LOCC-monotonicity and subadditivity. After relaxing the first condition to LO-monotonicity, we provide a simple method generating genuine multipartite entanglement monotones with the desired properties. Focusing on a subfamily of these monotones, we show that they are able to detect any form of genuine tripartite entanglement in three-qubit systems.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"不可约纠缠"这一强形式真多体纠缠概念：D≥3体态若不能分解为至多(D-1)体纠缠态的乘积，则为不可约D体纠缠。证明不存在同时满足LOCC单调性与次可加性的合理真多体纠缠熵，并将条件放宽为LO单调性后构造出生成此类单调量的方法，所构造子的子族可探测三量子比特系统中所有形式的真三体纠缠。
AI.motivation: 需要一个比标准真多体纠缠更强的纠缠形式刻画，并寻找可作为该纠缠"证书"的纯态纠缠单调量，以判断多体态是否可约分解。
AI.method: 先证明不可能性（no-go）定理：任何合理的真多体纠缠熵无法同时满足LOCC单调性与次可加性；随后将LOCC单调性放宽为LO单调性，给出构造满足所需性质的真多体纠缠单调量的简单方法，并聚焦其中一个子族进行分析。
AI.result: 得到LOCC单调性与次可加性不可兼得的否定性结论；在LO单调性下构造出有效单调量族，其中子族能够识别三量子比特系统中的任一类真三体纠缠。
AI.conclusion: "不可约纠缠"提供了更强的多体纠缠层级刻画；虽然严格LOCC框架下存在根本限制，但放宽至LO单调性可获得实用的纠缠证书，并在三量子比特情形下完备探测真三体纠缠。
