title: Full-chip constrained quantum annealing via self-calibrating spin-susceptibility control
summary: Discrete optimization in finance, power grids, and logistics requires minimizing Ising Hamiltonians under coupled linear constraints. However, quadratic-penalty formulations generate dense cliques that exhaust the minor-embedding capacity of sparse superconducting processors at 128-176 spins, and first-order dual subgradient schemes diverge or stall under constraint coupling. Accordingly, this study proposes a closed-loop primal-dual scheme, designated as Self-Calibrating Quantum Susceptibility Quasi-Newton (SelfCal-QSQN), in which linear constraints are encoded in longitudinal fields and dual curvature is reconstructed from single-shot spin-fluctuation covariances. This scheme requires no penalty couplers, slack qubits, or perturbation queries. Evaluated over 891 runs on D-Wave Advantage (5,612 qubits) and Advantage2 (4,560 qubits), SelfCal-QSQN achieves 83.3% full-chip exact feasibility, reduces high-constraint error by 6.1-20.1-fold over $K$-scaled first-order updates (138.4-323.3-fold over fixed-gain curvature), outperforms time-matched mixed-integer programming at 256 spins, and attains 95.0%-96.7% feasibility on non-native and inequality benchmarks. Moreover, the scheme is robust toward shot noise and freeze-out drift.

AI.tldr: 提出自校准量子磁化率拟牛顿法（SelfCal-QSQN），用纵向场编码线性约束、由单发自旋涨落协方差重构对偶曲率，无需罚项耦合/松弛量子比特/扰动查询，在D-Wave上实现83.3%全芯片精确可行性与数量级误差下降。
AI.motivation: 金融、电网与物流中的离散优化需在耦合线性约束下最小化Ising哈密顿量。二次罚项会产生稠密团（clique），在128–176自旋即耗尽稀疏超导芯片的次嵌入容量；而一阶对偶次梯度法在约束耦合下易发散或停滞。
AI.method: 闭环原始-对偶方案SelfCal-QSQN：将线性约束编码为纵向场（不引入罚项耦合器、松弛量子比特或扰动查询），并从单发（single-shot）自旋涨落协方差中重构对偶曲率，从而构造拟牛顿型对偶更新。
AI.result: 在D-Wave Advantage（5,612量子比特）与Advantage2（4,560量子比特）上共891次运行：全芯片精确可行率83.3%；高约束误差较K缩放一阶更新降低6.1–20.1倍（较固定增益曲率降低138.4–323.3倍）；256自旋时优于同等时间预算的混合整数规划；非原生与不等式基准上可行率95.0%–96.7%；对采样噪声与冻结漂移具鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 纵向场约束编码+协方差重构对偶曲率可绕开罚项嵌入瓶颈，在不增加量子比特与额外查询的前提下显著提升受约束Ising优化的可行性与精度，并具备硬件鲁棒性。

title: Single-realization Pauli twirling for suppressing coherent error accumulation in structured quantum circuits
summary: Pauli twirling is conventionally understood as an ensemble-level noise-tailoring procedure which suppresses coherent components of the error channel by averaging over randomized compilations. This picture does not by itself determine whether a single realization of Pauli-dressed circuit can outperform its bare counterpart, nor does it predict when such an advantage should occur. In this work, we present single-realization based framework for the standard Pauli dressing of two-qubit Clifford gates in structured quantum circuits. This is afforded by the key insight that for weak coherent errors, the leading gate infidelity is governed by the variance of some accumulated error generator. Through both simulations and theoretical considerations, we verify that coherent errors accumulated at different entangling gates can produce $Θ(L^2)$ variance growth in a bare circuit, whereas independent Pauli dressing eliminates the cross-layer contribution on average and yields an $O(L)$ variance bound at any fixed confidence level for a single randomly sampled realization. We then develop a covariance diagnostic that predicts when this mechanism is effective in error mitigation. We find a strong Pauli twirling advantage for coherent errors whose transported generators have large off-diagonal covariance, and little advantage when the covariance matrix is nearly diagonal. Hardware experiments on IBM superconducting processors demonstrate fidelity improvements for GHZ-state preparation and reduced observable errors in Trotterized transverse-field Ising dynamics. These results indicate that single realizations of Pauli twirling without ensemble averaging is a useful coherent-error suppression technique for structured circuits containing repeated nontrivial two-qubit operations.

AI.tldr: 本文从单次实现（single-realization）视角重构Pauli twirling，指出弱相干误差下门不保真度由累积误差生成元的方差主导；裸电路中跨层相干误差产生Θ(L²)方差增长，而独立Pauli dressing平均消除跨层贡献，使单次随机采样的方差上界为O(L)。作者提出协方差诊断量预测该方法何时有效，并在IBM超导处理器上验证。
AI.motivation: 传统上Pauli twirling被理解为系综层面的噪声整饰手段，通过随机化编译平均掉误差信道的相干分量。该图像本身无法回答两个问题：单次Pauli-dressed实现能否优于裸电路，以及这种优势在何种条件下出现。论文旨在建立单次实现层面的理论框架来刻画这一点。
AI.method: 针对结构化量子电路中双比特Clifford门的标准Pauli dressing，构建单次实现分析框架。核心洞察是：对弱相干误差，主导的门不保真度由累积误差生成元的方差决定。结���模拟与理论分析，比较裸电路与独立Pauli dressing下方差的增长行为，并构造一个协方差诊断量（基于传输后生成元的协方差矩阵结构）来预测抑制效果。最后在IBM超导处理器上开展硬件实验。
AI.result: 理论上与模拟中验证：裸电路在不同纠缠门累积的相干误差可导致Θ(L²)的方差增长；独立Pauli dressing在平均意义上消除跨层贡献，并在任意固定置信水平下对单次随机采样给出O(L)的方差界。诊断表明当传输后生成元具有较大非对角协方差时Pauli twirling优势显著，协方差矩阵近似对角时优势微弱。硬件实验在GHZ态制备中显示保真度提升，在Trotter化横场Ising动力学中显示可观测量误差降低。
AI.conclusion: 无需系综平均的Pauli twirling单次实现即可作为有效的相干误差抑制技术，适用于包含重复非平凡双比特操作的结构化电路；其有效性可由误差生成元的协方差结构预先诊断。

title: Beyond the Stabilizer Norm: Physicality and Resource Allocation in Pauli-Limited Quantum Certification
summary: Certification from restricted and uncertain Pauli measurements can be posed as a robust optimization problem: among all physical channels consistent with the data, how small can the fidelity with a target channel be? We first study a linear relaxation that ignores positivity and show that it is exactly characterized by a single scalar, the stabilizer norm of the target Choi state, $s_{\mathrm{wit}}(U)=\|C_U\|_{\mathrm{st}}-1/D$. We then ask whether this scalar continues to determine robustness once the positivity constraint is restored. It does not. We derive a necessary and sufficient KKT condition for the relaxation to remain tight, together with a dual obstruction certifying a strict gap, and give a rigorous computer-assisted proof that two distinct two-qubit targets can have exactly the same stabilizer norm but different physical robustness. The KKT condition depends on structure discarded by the stabilizer norm, including the support and relative signs of the Choi-Pauli coefficients and the algebraic relations among the corresponding Pauli operators. We use this structure to derive simpler sufficient certificates for a strict gap. The dual coefficients also determine how measurement uncertainty enters the finite-data fidelity bound. For a fixed budget, we derive exact shot-allocation rules for a fixed certificate and for compatible observables obtained from shared measurement settings, and we formulate the corresponding joint certificate-design problem. The conjecture that every full-support two-qubit target has positive gain remains open.

AI.tldr: 该文将受限/不确定Pauli测量下的认证写成鲁棒优化问题：在所有与数据一致的物理信道中，与目标信道的保真度能多小？作者发现忽略正性的线性松弛恰由单个标量（目标Choi态的stabilizer范数 s_wit(U)=‖C_U‖_st−1/D）刻画；但恢复正性约束后该标量不再决定鲁棒性。给出松弛保持紧的充要KKT条件及严格间隙的对偶阻碍，并用计算机辅助严格证明两个不同双量子比特目标具有相同stabilizer范数但不同的物理鲁棒性，最后给出测量不确定性的有限数据界与射击分配规则。
AI.motivation: 将受限且不确定Pauli测量下的认证表述为鲁棒优化问题，即在与数据一致的所有物理信道中最小化与目标信道的保真度，并判断简单的标量范数（stabilizer范数）能否充分刻画这种最坏情形鲁棒性。
AI.method: 先研究忽略正性的线性松弛，证明其恰由单一标量——目标Choi态的stabilizer范数 s_wit(U)=‖C_U‖_st−1/D——完全刻画；再恢复正性约束，推导松弛仍保持紧的充要KKT条件，以及证明严格间隙（strict gap）的对偶阻碍；利用KKT条件所依赖的结构（Choi-Pauli系数的支撑与相对符号、相应Pauli算符间的代数关系）导出更简单的严格间隙充分证书；并分析对偶系数如何决定测量不确定性进入有限数据保真度界，进而推导固定预算下的精确射击分配规则与联合证书设计问题。
AI.result: 线性松弛被单一stabilizer范数精确刻画；但加入正性约束后该标量不再决定鲁棒性。给出充要KKT条件与严格间隙对偶阻碍，并用严格计算机辅助证明构造了两个不同的双量子比特目标，其stabilizer范数完全相同但物理鲁棒性不同。
AI.conclusion: stabilizer范数不足以刻画带正性约束的物理鲁棒性，KKT条件所依赖的Choi-Pauli系数结构（支撑、相对符号及Pauli算符代数关系）是必要信息；据此得到更简单的严格间隙充分证书，并由对偶系数给出固定证书与共享测量设置下相容可观测量情形的精确射击分配规则及联合证书设计问题；"每个满支撑双量子比特目标都有正增益"的猜想仍未解决。

title: Quantum conditional relative entropy and quasi-factorization
comment: Submitted as chapter for the book "Entropy, Relative Entropy, and Quantum Information Theory"
summary:
One of the characteristic features that distinguishes quantum systems from classical ones is the inability, except for some special cases, of defining a conditional expectation map for a given quantum state, namely a map that restricts observables to a given sub-region (or more generally, a sub-algebra of observables) while preserving expectation values. Of the many consequences of this lack of conditional expectation, we consider the problem of defining the quantum conditional relative entropy, i.e., the relative entropy between two quantum states conditioned to a sub-region or sub-algebra. We discuss how, when the conditional expectation map is not defined, there are multiple, non-equivalent ways to define a quantum conditional relative entropy quantity, and we present some of their properties.
  Classical conditional relative entropy has played a fundamental role in many applications to spin systems, and in particular in proving logarithmic Sobolev inequalities. A key feature of conditional relative entropy that intervenes in these results is its quasi-factorization or approximate tensorization property: informally, the relative entropy is almost super-additive over weakly-dependent sub-algebras. It is then not surprising that the key to obtaining similar applications in the quantum setting, such as quantum logarithmic Sobolev inequalities in spin systems, has been to obtain approximate factorization results for the quantum conditional relative entropy, with the added complication that there is not a unique definition of conditional relative entropy to work with. We review the recent results regarding quasi-factorization of the quantum conditional relative entropy, in strong and weak forms.

AI.tldr: 量子系统一般不存在保持期望值的条件期望映射，故量子条件相对熵有多种不等价定义；本文综述其定义、性质及近期关于强/弱拟因子化（近似张量化）结果，服务于量子对数Sobolev不等式等应用。
AI.motivation: 经典条件相对熵在自旋系统与对数Sobolev不等式证明中至关重要，其关键性质是对弱依赖子代数近似超可加（拟因子化）。量子情形因缺乏条件期望映射而变得复杂，需要厘清能否以及如何移植这些工具。
AI.method: 概念性综述与比较分析：以“条件期望映射一般不存在”为出发点，梳理量子条件相对熵的多种非等价定义方式，比较其性质，并归纳近期关于量子条件相对熵强、弱两种形式拟因子化（近似张量化）的成果。
AI.result: 在条件期望缺失时，量子条件相对熵存在多个互不等价定义；针对这些定义已建立强形式与弱形式的拟因子化/近似张量化结果，但结论依赖于所选定义。
AI.conclusion: 量子条件相对熵的拟因子化是量子自旋系统中对数Sobolev不等式等应用的枢纽，但定义非唯一性带来的额外困难使结果呈现定义依赖性，需按强、弱形式分别讨论。

title: Complex chaotic Boltzmann machines as deterministic representations of quantum states
summary: Neural networks and tensor networks have opened new ways to explore quantum systems by parameterizing families of wave functions through the structure and parameters of a network. Here we extend this perspective to a dynamical representation: we introduce a complex chaotic Boltzmann machine that assigns a deterministic system to a pure quantum state. We extend Suzuki's construction to incorporate both Born probabilities and relative phases. The probabilities set the trajectory velocities in a hypercube, while the phases define a complex field that lifts its Poincare sections. The evolution is determined by the network parameters and initial conditions, without random choices during flights or configuration changes. Our analysis of two qubits and study of three-qubit families show how relations between probabilities organize regular curves, islands, and unstable regions, and how phases distinguish states that share the same Born dynamics. This architecture turns a wave-function parameterization into a geometry of trajectories, providing a tool to explore probabilities, phases, and symmetries together across families of states.

AI.tldr: 提出"复混沌玻尔兹曼机"，将纯量子态映射为确定性动力学系统：Born概率设定超立方体上的轨迹速度，相对相位构成复场以实现Poincaré截面的"提升"，从而把波函数参数化转化为轨迹几何。
AI.motivation: 神经网络与张量网络通过结构与参数化波函数族来研究量子系统，但缺乏对量子态的动态（轨迹）表征；同时Suzuki的构造只涉及概率，未包含相对相位，难以区分具有相同Born动力学的不同量子态。
AI.method: 构造复混沌玻尔兹曼机，将确定性的混沌系统指派给纯量子态；扩展Suzuki构造，同时纳入Born概率与相对相位：概率决定超立方体中的轨迹速度，相位定义复场并对其Poincaré截面做提升；演化完全由网络参数与初始条件决定，飞行与位形变化过程中不含随机选择。
AI.result: 对两量子比特的分析及三量子比特态族的研究显示：概率之间的关系会组织出规则曲线、岛（islands）与不稳定区域；相位能够区分共享同一Born动力学的不同状态。
AI.conclusion: 该架构把波函数参数化转化为轨迹几何，为在态族层面同时探索概率、相位与对称性提供了工具。

title: Penalty-Free Constrained Optimization on Dynamic Quantum Circuits via Phase-Protected Tunneling and Closed-Loop Spectral Ratchets
summary: Embedding hard operational constraints into an unconstrained Hamiltonian via large penalty multipliers induces quadratic spectral aliasing during phase estimation and increases two-qubit gate depth. This paper proposes a penalty-free, closed-loop dynamic quantum circuit scheme, designated as Zeno-decoupled gauge-ratchet optimization (Z-GRO), for constrained binary optimization without outer-loop training. Reversible feasibility phase operators within symmetric dynamical-decoupling echoes confine evolution to the feasible subspace, while an interaction-correlated commutator gauge operator resolves initial symmetry stall. Directional cooling couples the unpenalized objective Hamiltonian to a reusable ancilla with a zero-two-qubit-gate threshold offset, bypassing echoed tunneling gates on retained branches. A survival-filtered Ramsey controller advances the threshold from a linear-programming bound with automatic overshoot rollback. Exact density-matrix and trajectory simulations on spin-glass and quadratic knapsack ensembles show a single-check discrimination gain above four orders of magnitude, improving ground-state probability by factors of 3.0 to 4.3 over quantum Zeno dynamics and 11.4 to 22.5 over penalized schemes. Z-GRO reduces the spin-glass time-to-solution scaling base to 1.529 (compared to 1.684 for quantum Zeno dynamics and 1.909 to 2.047 for penalized schemes) and lowers 14-qubit knapsack time-to-solution by factors of 2.4 to 14.5. For two-qubit gate error rates between $5 \times 10^{-4}$ and $5 \times 10^{-3}$, Z-GRO achieves 2.9 to 7.0 times the optimal probability of noisy penalized feedback, while majority shielding limits loss to 6.3% at a 5.0% readout bit-flip rate, recording 0/24, 0/25, 0/96, 3/25, and 2/80 overshoots.

AI.tldr: 提出无罚项、闭环动态量子线路方案Z-GRO，利用Zeno可行性相位算符与规范算符消除训练外环，在受约束二进制优化上显著优于量子Zeno动力学与罚项方案。
AI.motivation: 用大罚因子把硬约束嵌入无约束哈密顿量，会在相位估计中引起二次谱混叠，并增大双比特门深度；同时现有受约束量子优化多依赖昂贵的外环训练。
AI.method: Z-GRO：在对称动力学解耦回波内嵌入可逆可行性相位算符，将演化限制在可行子空间；用相互作用关联的对易子规范算符打破初始对称停滞；方向性冷却将无罚目标哈密顿量与可复用辅助比特耦合，采用零双比特门阈值的阈值偏置；由生存滤波Ramsey控制器依据线性规划界推进阈值，并自动回滚过冲。
AI.result: 密度矩阵与轨迹模拟（自旋玻璃与二次背包系综）：单次校验判别增益>4个数量级；基态概率较量子Zeno动力学提升3.0–4.3倍、较罚项方案提升11.4–22.5倍；自旋玻璃TTS标度基降至1.529（QZD 1.684，罚项1.909–2.047）；14比特背包TTS降低2.4–14.5倍；双比特门错误率5e-4–5e-3下达到含噪罚项反馈最优概率的2.9–7.0倍；5.0%读出比特翻转率下多数屏蔽将损失限制在6.3%；过冲记录0/24、0/25、0/96、3/25、2/80。
AI.conclusion: 无需罚项与外环训练的动态量子线路可实现受约束二进制优化的高效求解，并在噪声与读出误差下保持鲁棒性。

title: Tackling Many-Body Coulomb Singularity by Randomization
summary: Many-body Coulomb dynamics is central to quantum chemistry and molecular simulation, yet the Coulomb singularity undermines both the standard error analysis and performance of product formulas. Even for the simple hydrogen ground state, the celebrated Trotter formulas converge more slowly than their nominal order, and going to higher order does not help. Randomization by itself does not resolve this. We show that conventional qDRIFT suffers the same loss of accuracy, and that for general initial states, the errors of both Trotter formulas and qDRIFT can decrease more slowly than any power of the number of time steps (logarithmically). To overcome these limitations, we introduce supersmoothing qDRIFT, a randomized product formula that turns a physical property of free particle propagation into an algorithmic resource. Our algorithm achieves an error bound that decreases linearly with the time step, uniformly over \textit{all} initial states and without any smoothness or energy assumptions. Combined with spatial discretization analysis, the resulting end-to-end gate count improves on those of qubitization and high-order Trotter formulas applied directly to the discretized Hamiltonian, despite first-order convergence in time. This work demonstrates new ways of utilizing continuum dynamics to achieve algorithmic advantage.

AI.tldr: 本文指出库仑奇异性使Trotter公式与qDRIFT在氢原子基态等情形下丧失名义阶数，误差甚至可随步数以对数速率衰减；提出supersmoothing qDRIFT，利用自由粒子传播的物理性质，得到对所有初态一致且随时间步长线性下降的误差界，端到端门数优于量子化(qubitization)与高阶Trotter。
AI.motivation: 多体库仑动力学是量子化学与分子模拟的核心，但库仑奇异性既破坏标准误差分析，也损害乘积公式性能：即便氢原子基态，Trotter公式收敛慢于名义阶数，提高阶数无益，随机化本身也无法解决，qDRIFT同样损失精度。作者意在突破这一瓶颈。
AI.method: 先构造反例/误差下界分析：证明传统qDRIFT与Trotter公式在一般初态下误差可慢于步数的任意幂（对数级收敛）。进而提出supersmoothing qDRIFT——一种随机化乘积公式，将自由粒子传播的物理性质（平滑性）转化为算法资源，实现误差随时间步长线性下降，且对全部初态一致，无需平滑性或能量假设；再结合空间离散化分析给出端到端门数估计。
AI.result: 传统Trotter与qDRIFT存在误差下界（对数收敛）；supersmoothing qDRIFT获得线性于一阶步长的统一误差界；结合离散化后，尽管时间上仅一阶收敛，其端到端门数仍优于直接对离散哈密顿量使用qubitization与高阶Trotter公式。
AI.conclusion: 库仑奇异性是乘积公式精度与效率的根本障碍，随机化不能自行消除；通过把连续介质动力学（自由传播）的结构性性质设计进算法，可绕过奇异性并获得优于既有最优方法的复杂度，展示了利用连续动力学获取算法优势的新途径。

title: World Models for Learning Quantum Many-Body Dynamics
summary: We propose using world models for learning Hamiltonians from measured dynamics of a quantum computer or simulator. Implicitly, the parameters of a Hamiltonian are encoded in how the measured few-body observables evolve. By using a joint-embedding predictive architecture (JEPA) to perform prediction in latent space, we show that the device Hamiltonian can be efficiently inferred from noisy measurements. We train a spatiotemporal encoder and predictor with approximately $2.7$ million trainable weights using a single objective, to predict the representation of the next window of measurements from the previous one. The network is thereby driven to retain the reproducible dynamics and discard shot noise. We recover the field and coupling maps of a two-dimensional Ising lattice in real and imaginary time, and the disorder map of a one-dimensional Heisenberg chain of $100$ sites. In every settings the encoder achieves lower error than a masked autoencoder and than the same encoder left untrained. It also outperforms the same regression head applied directly to time-averaged observables, by factors of $4.4$ to $30$. We establish latent prediction as a practical self-supervised objective for learning from measurements of quantum dynamics.

AI.tldr: 用JEPA在潜空间做自监督预测，从含噪声的量子测量动力学中高效反演哈密顿量参数（场、耦合、无序图）。
AI.motivation: 哈密顿量参数隐含在少体可观测量随时间的演化中，但实测数据含散粒噪声，直接回归或掩码重建易受噪声干扰，需要一种能保留可复现动力学、丢弃散粒噪声的学习目标。
AI.method: 提出用世界模型学习哈密顿量：采用联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA），训练约270万参数的空时编码器与预测器，单一目标——由前一个测量窗口的表示预测下一窗口的表示，在潜空间进行预测，从而隐式编码哈密顿量参数并抑制散粒噪声。
AI.result: 恢复二维Ising晶格的场图与耦合图（实时间与虚时间），以及100格点一维Heisenberg链的无序图；各设定下编码器误差均低于掩码自编码器及未训练编码器，并比直接对时间平均可观测量做回归的误差低4.4至30倍。
AI.conclusion: 潜空间预测是一种实用的自监督目标，可用于从量子动力学测量中学习；JEPA式世界模型为哈密顿量层析提供了高效、抗噪的途径。

title: The moments and asymptotic spectral distribution of the Grassmannian ensemble
summary: In this paper, we study random density matrices constructed by taking partial traces of projections onto random subspaces of a bipartite Hilbert space $\mathcal{H}_A \otimes \mathcal{H}_{B}$ distributed according to the pushforward measure of the action of the unitary group on the Grassmannian $\text{Gr}_{n}(\mathcal{H}_A \otimes \mathcal{H}_{B})$. This ensemble models a `typical' quantum subspace. All tracial moments of the density operator, as well as mixed tracial moments of reduced density operators, are computed explicitly using Weingarten calculus. There are several consequences of these results. In particular, we prove that the empirical spectral distribution of the density operator converges almost surely to a rescaled Marchenko-Pastur law. We also prove that this ensemble can be written as a sum of asymptotically free random density operators, leading to an alternative proof of the convergence of the spectral distribution. Finally, we compute the asymptotic expansion of the average entanglement entropy.

AI.tldr: 研究双分体Hilbert空间随机子空间投影偏迹所得随机密度矩阵系综，用Weingarten calculus显式计算各类迹矩，证明经验谱分布几乎必然收敛到缩放Marchenko-Pastur律，并给出渐近自由分解与纠缠熵渐近展开。
AI.motivation: 随机密度矩阵的谱性质与纠缠熵是量子信息与随机矩阵理论的交叉核心问题，需要一个刻画"典型量子子空间"的、可精确计算的系综模型。
AI.method: 取Grassmannian上酉群作用pushforward测度下的随机子空间投影，对其偏迹得到密度矩阵；利用Weingarten calculus显式计算密度算子的全部迹矩及约化密度算子的混合迹矩；并结合自由概率工具研究渐近谱分布。
AI.result: 迹矩有显式闭式表达；经验谱分布几乎必然收敛到缩放的Marchenko-Pastur律；该系综可分解为渐近自由随机密度算子之和，从而给出谱分布收敛的另一证明；并得到平均纠缠熵的渐近展开。
AI.conclusion: 该随机子空间系综在谱层面等价于缩放Marchenko-Pastur分布且具有渐近自由结构，为随机密度矩阵谱与纠缠熵的定量刻画提供了可计算框架。

title: Transpilation-Aware Multi-Vendor QPU Scheduling with Predicted Post-Transpilation Fidelity
comment: 24 pages, 11 figures, 10 tables. Code, data and scripts to reproduce all experiments: https://github.com/anapaulaappel/QPUScheduler
summary: Cluster schedulers already choose nodes, GPUs and accelerators for submitted workloads, enforce quotas and spread load. QPUs from several vendors are now schedulable resources in the same clusters, yet the user still names the device, usually the one with the best average fidelity. For a given circuit that choice is often wrong: compiling onto each device's qubit connectivity adds gates, so a job can meet its required success probability on one device and miss it on another with similar error rates, and checking this exactly by compiling for every candidate is too slow for a scheduling decision. We let the scheduler choose the QPU in two stages. A training-free estimate predicts, in milliseconds and without compiling, the success probability on every candidate and filters out those that would miss the requirement; only the chosen device then compiles the circuit, re-checks it, and binds the job or rolls back. The estimate matches compiling every candidate at about 25x lower latency in simulation, ranks measured success on IBM hardware as well as the post-compilation estimate (Spearman rho = 0.95), reduces requirement violations from tens of jobs to a few, and avoids them under contention without piling jobs onto one device. Across vendors it works when error rates are comparable (IBM and IQM) and fails when published figures overstate a device.

AI.tldr: 提出一种两阶段的量子处理器（QPU）调度选择方法：用免训练、毫秒级的估算模型预测各候选设备上的成功概率并过滤不达标者，仅对选定设备做实际编译与复核，从而在保证成功率要求的同时降低调度延迟。
AI.motivation: 集群调度器已能分配节点、GPU 与加速器，多个厂商的 QPU 也成为可调度资源，但用户仍按“平均保真度最高”手工指定设备。由于编译到不同设备的量子比特连接性会引入不同数量的额外门，同一电路在错误率相近的设备上可能一个达标、一个不达标；而逐一编译所有候选来精确判断又太慢，无法用于调度决策。
AI.method: 两阶段调度：(1) 免训练估算器在不编译的情况下以毫秒级预测每个候选 QPU 上的成功率，剔除不满足需求者；(2) 仅对选定设备执行编译、复检，并据此绑定作业或回滚。
AI.result: 仿真中估算结果与逐一编译所有候选一致，延迟约低 25 倍；在 IBM 硬件上对实测成功率的排序能力与编译后估算相当（Spearman ρ = 0.95）；将需求违例从数十个作业降至少数几个，并在资源竞争下避免违例且不把作业堆积到单一设备。跨厂商时，错误率可比（IBM 与 IQM）情形下有效，而当公布的指标高估设备性能时失效。
AI.conclusion: 由调度器依据快速免编译估算来选择 QPU 是可行且高效的，可作为集群中量子资源的通用调度策略；其有效性的前提是厂商公布的错误率数据可靠。

title: A Microwave-Photonics Formulation of the Rydberg-Atom Receiver
summary: The performance of Rydberg-atom receivers is seldom stated as a radio-frequency (RF) link budget. The receiver is shown to be an intensity-modulated direct-detection analog optical link whose modulator is the laser-driven vapor. The transmission of a warm vapor is derived in closed form by averaging the four-level response over atomic velocities. The conversion gain, noise figure, bandwidth, intercept points, and spurious-free dynamic range follow from this one function. For a weak probe the instantaneous bandwidth is half the width of the transparency window in two-photon detuning. The local-oscillator beat places the second-order intercept near twice the local-oscillator field, so the local oscillator sets the even-order linearity. For a rubidium transition at 17.04 GHz the closed forms agree with a velocity-resolved density-matrix model to 1% for the slope and the intercepts and to 10% for the bandwidth. They underestimate the group delay by a third. The response is tied to atomic constants, and the sensing volume escapes the Chu limit. However, the noise figure of a warm vapor rules it out as a general replacement for an antenna and low-noise amplifier.

AI.tldr: 将里德堡原子接收机重新表述为强度调制-直接探测（IM-DD）模拟光链路，其调制器为激光驱动的原子蒸气；用速度平均的四能级响应的闭式解统一导出增益、噪声、带宽与线性度指标。
AI.motivation: 里德堡原子接收机的性能很少以射频链路预算（link budget）的形式表述，导致其与传统天线+低噪放的比较缺乏统一框架，也难以界定其适用边界。
AI.method: 把接收机建模为调制器为原子蒸气的IM-DD模拟光链路；对四能级响应按原子速度分布平均，得到热蒸气透射率的闭式解；由该单一函数导出转换增益、噪声系数、带宽、截点（二阶/三阶）与无杂散动态范围；并结合17.04 GHz铷跃迁与速度分辨密度矩阵模型对比验证。
AI.result: 弱探测下瞬时带宽为双光子失谐透明窗口宽度的一半；本振拍频使二阶截点约为本振场强的两倍，即偶次线性度由本振设定。闭式解与密度矩阵模型一致：斜率与截点误差约1%，带宽误差约10%，群延迟低估约三分之一。响应由原子常数决定，感测体积可突破Chu极限。
AI.conclusion: 该框架以原子常数为基础，将里德堡接收机性能纳入标准RF链路预算语言，并可突破Chu极限；但热蒸气的噪声系数偏高，使其难以作为天线加低噪放的通用替代方案，而更适合特定场景。

title: Nonperturbative Bounds on the Ground-State Energy of Lattice QED
summary: We establish nonperturbative bounds on the ground-state energy of lattice quantum electrodynamics with naive fermions in Coulomb gauge, within the Gaussian photon approximation. Our central result is a spectral comparison theorem showing that, in the thermodynamic limit, the minimum fermionic energy density over all link configurations coincides with that of the trivial gauge configuration. The proof exploits a logarithmic determinant representation and dimensional reduction, without relying on reflection positivity, and applies to lattices of either parity. Combining this result with the positivity of the electromagnetic and Coulomb Hamiltonians, we derive an explicit lower bound on the interacting ground-state energy. Finite-lattice counterexamples show that the thermodynamic limit is essential.

AI.tldr: 在格点QED（naive费米子、库仑规范、高斯光子近似）下，作者证明热力学极限中遍及所有链变量的最小费米子能量密度与平凡规范位形相等，从而给出相互作用基态能量的显式非微扰下界。
AI.motivation: 格点规范理论中基态能量的非微扰控制通常依赖反射正定性等工具，而在库仑规范、高斯光子近似、naive费米子这一设置下缺乏严格下界；作者希望在不使用反射正定性的前提下建立此类界。
AI.method: 证明一个谱比较定理：利用费米子行列式的对数表示与维数约化，论证热力学极限下所有链位形上的最小费米子能量密度等于平凡规范位形的值；结论对偶数与奇数格均成立。再结合电磁哈密顿量与库仑哈密顿量的正定性，得到相互作用基态能量的显式下界。并用有限格反例说明热力学极限的必要性。
AI.result: 建立了热力学极限下最小费米子能量密度等于平凡位形值的谱比较定理；由此导出相互作用基态能量的显式数值下界；有限格上存在反例，表明该结论本质依赖热力学极限。
AI.conclusion: 在高斯光子近似的库仑规范格点QED中，基态能量可获得不依赖反射正定性的严格非微扰下界，其有效性以热力学极限为前提。
